Jeanne Hendricks is a nurse anesthetist, Mom and community activist who makes decisions every day based on facts and science. | **Hi, my name is Charlie Crist, and I just became the Democratic nominee for governor of Florida.**

My opponent? **_Gov. Ron DeSantis,_** one of the most dangerous Republicans nationwide.

Ron DeSantis has been using Florida as a testing ground for some of the most cruel and divisive culture war tactics of the last two years. He has been setting himself up as a likely presidential contender, and it’s been working.

DeSantis signed one of the first vile “Don’t Say Gay” bills. He attacked Disney and the Special Olympics when they opposed his policies. He’s even created an “elections police” unit that people fear will be more about voter intimidation than voter protection. [DeSantis’s next act is to run for president in 2024, and that’s why I’m writing to you today. This election is our last, best chance to stop Gov. subject: happy dance time
body:

Friend,

Let me start by saying this. I’m not a millionaire.
I don’t have enough money to even *think* about self-funding our campaign for U.S. Senate.
And I certainly don’t have million$ to throw around like Dr. Oz + his super PACs.
When I say we’re a grassroots campaign funded by people like you, I mean it.
We don’t take a single dollar for granted. Each + every dollar we raise is used strategically to help reach + mobilize voters across the Commonwealth. In fact, a couple campaign staffers even get an automated email alert every single time someone donates.
(Yep, that means when you donate to this email, someone on the finance team will see it and do a little Happy Dance. 😂)
Believe me when I say your donation will not go unseen or unappreciated. In a tough race like this, every single dollar makes a huge difference. I really just couldn’t be more grateful for your support.
**[Want to inspire a Happy Dance today, friend? Split a donation of any amount between our campaign + Raphael Warnock's before our upcoming midnight deadline. Peter,

Today is the day of reckoning - yesterday I wrote to you that the RNC gave me a deadline of raising $100,000 by August 31st in order to be considered for their candidate assistance program. Well, the day is here and we've still $5,000 left ro raise.

Just when we thought that the stakes couldn't get any higher, **the Democrats announced on Monday that they're investing $360,000 in the race on behalf of my opponent.**

I think that it's fair to say we're going to be between a rock and a hard place if we cannot unlock help from the national Party.

The full email from yesterday can be found below. **[If you can help with a donation of any amount today it would mean the world to me and my team.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=32b9e02d4c574a7a960a7b6f5c314cf4&_e=nZrdKj_pipb2Ua6mdHvRIqGhytfFzV5MSBK4HV0MvZnCAwAdXDEwztMYMy0-0VpgJIF64Ij4b2hlzktK29jYZDkv9x3lcX6fbKDy68kSL1gAmPy6X_5ZEz62iffzQ96t8MMRVnOX-rbXhOEi2yWBJ1h4JwhwbbD1H-qEbJ4vn8n0zUXaJwat2cUMD1f-KwD2AnCEWK4kmVAOUCsy6NGbpQdFd3lS8OMyCAY8CJI95ntVWbmTrwgRgIq0QvfDMJ-usrCZSXnUGs1T2J2BxNY2Jc7loT16gqNwaOlXAeJYackAFjJE-hFHA7C99_XIpsJv0P3YXbLbiIiO8FrIBrXYcfuRcRlijz4gaBk3wwhXykU9wfiHhWnUhTDc2BLv0IQgJ6IuA6sh2XMybH3s2gmEkphEBZ-MqFnU30a7uhqzyatn8pmLKxrSJgwJgTJTFqfHP1sbcaSYIcs13bt8lh42hw%3D%3D)**

From: Alek Skarlatos
Date: Tuesday, August 30, 2022 at 11:27 AM
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Subject: I've been given an ultimatum

\-----------------------------------------

clean_body: It’s time we send LIONS to Congress, to solve modern-day challenges and get America back on track. | | Fellow American, My name is Catalina Lauf and I have a passion for people, public service and fighting for our American values. I’m running for Congress in Illinois’ 11th Congressional District, but before I get into that - I’d like to tell you a little bit about my story. My mom worked three-jobs at minimum wage to emigrate to America and became a leader in the community. My father grew-up with parents who barely made it through the Great Depression – yet started his own business and became a successful entrepreneur. My parents taught me the value of hard-work, liberty and to have an unapologetic love for our Country. I worked in the private sector (and still do for a growing startup!) and was a Presidential political appointee at the U.S. Department of Commerce, working on small-business initiatives, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act and pro-growth policies. We may not agree all the time. But know that by electing me as your Representative, you will be sending a fighter to Congress. One who will fight for what matters to YOU, one who is not afraid to disrupt the system, and one who will be a fresh-face and new perspective to Washington. I need your support in order to continue fighting fearlessly for you, and your family. The Democrats are watching this race closely and working hard to see me lose. Nancy Pelosi and her Democrat friends in the House, know I won’t stand for their “business as usual” politics - which leaves Americans out to dry. Please JOIN MY FIGHT today. the Five Ws

| [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=999502a38d00467a96c6fbcc728ee402&_e=UB0DEmmkrmf-XbN_JyG2oXa9wvAGJruZrOcAAfyrIdjs3w3JLt-C5SFfsqeG9q_gIrE-gPYlwNb2Fwi2GwJiQY7FE_4dnHCoay21rZ5slHUy1aVgwDF5R2fV95fBISKAs08tvUSUIE68xT9wfTV1U2pi2Ct_vLS3g0QQ9mer3SM0cBO6IECNmMoKsr5q_ZpjMxUqPWk48aSW68X0rW0tY23gZsFozK8x9nrXc7in42fSmS9v4ejEnb34COtXVHAhcF93fnEWoLXVhogx-vqIINnrGBSsCD3EQahzOprKG-T7WVMfG-0llQwBKH_iDjx7cacT_8Y7Fn9y7N5-xCbMs1tEcI_-2q57TGl7pDVebiZaqvn6xH2ISPQvQGx0hHOWKrsT-vIg90xceT2IyOnb9dZNl3tp_UNWvMu7vXV8quRdXQIJvJo26fCauzR4UUKgmTJXsHEmkHMuqJv1n3faxbiN8my1qEzhCmwDu4nlWeo%3D)
---
It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important...

**The beginning:** My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=999502a38d00467a96c6fbcc728ee402&_e=UB0DEmmkrmf-XbN_JyG2oXa9wvAGJruZrOcAAfyrIdjs3w3JLt-C5SFfsqeG9q_gIrE-gPYlwNb2Fwi2GwJiQY7FE_4dnHCoay21rZ5slHUy1aVgwDF5R2fV95fBISKAs08tvUSUIE68xT9wfTV1U2pi2Ct_vLS3g0QQ9mer3SM0cBO6IECNmMoKsr5q_ZpjMxUqPWk48aSW68X0rW0tY23gZsFozK8x9nrXc7in42fSmS9v4ejEnb34COtXVHAhcF93fnEWoLXVhogx-vqIINnrGBSsCD3EQahzOprKG-T7WVMfG-0llQwBKH_iDjx7cacT_8Y7Fn9y7N5-xCbMs8-eFQ1Lf7eKjtFQIBD94MtVeMcF698uJ0V3xEJ22LR2KFsdDq_qrx4vwd2OUS_GN6PZPgU1OUxJkQ15y44p5STruBiFDPAfsX_G0ssDOl8TbFL9_rURi8_dw9V1CdTBOA5lW3aJ-Nfc5Ety5oYa5O0%3D)
This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=999502a38d00467a96c6fbcc728ee402&_e=UB0DEmmkrmf-XbN_JyG2oXa9wvAGJruZrOcAAfyrIdjs3w3JLt-C5SFfsqeG9q_gIrE-gPYlwNb2Fwi2GwJiQY7FE_4dnHCoay21rZ5slHUy1aVgwDF5R2fV95fBISKAs08tvUSUIE68xT9wfTV1U2pi2Ct_vLS3g0QQ9mer3SM0cBO6IECNmMoKsr5q_ZpjMxUqPWk48aSW68X0rW0tY23gZsFozK8x9nrXc7in42fSmS9v4ejEnb34COtXVHAhcF93fnEWoLXVhogx-vqIINnrGBSsCD3EQahzOprKG-T7WVMfG-0llQwBKH_iDjx7cacT_8Y7Fn9y7N5-xCbMsyX9aR2RZLPQRVWeQ-RoRXVI4yw7pJOKFpR18uUasBaELtkwZjC1zkUCxafIUfC21IY6LJIB36mxwS6wyv_3s4apuV4bAUNMvBexxT25F00KAgci31mAfWsRv2IxiA0o66L-NjTF5R0ERHZ0OqHNxok%3D)
**The middle:** I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=999502a38d00467a96c6fbcc728ee402&_e=UB0DEmmkrmf-XbN_JyG2oXa9wvAGJruZrOcAAfyrIdjs3w3JLt-C5SFfsqeG9q_gIrE-gPYlwNb2Fwi2GwJiQY7FE_4dnHCoay21rZ5slHUy1aVgwDF5R2fV95fBISKAs08tvUSUIE68xT9wfTV1U2pi2Ct_vLS3g0QQ9mer3SM0cBO6IECNmMoKsr5q_ZpjMxUqPWk48aSW68X0rW0tY23gZsFozK8x9nrXc7in42fSmS9v4ejEnb34COtXVHAhcF93fnEWoLXVhogx-vqIINnrGBSsCD3EQahzOprKG-T7WVMfG-0llQwBKH_iDjx7cacT_8Y7Fn9y7N5-xCbMsyebSmNu7_H_UNSR-AJlddf0YmrWGbZ1CTu2_oHoKVBA_wTtAu59PZwI32g0kRI6XqDhGLM7_4yEaKqji20EaQm4A_WC0NJV65oAv8xxr7sZJSpyKqaY6eUbzfFJSXtOoYo6JZjj2gITfPxY5KBjyxw%3D)
Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate:

**You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree.**
[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=999502a38d00467a96c6fbcc728ee402&_e=UB0DEmmkrmf-XbN_JyG2oXa9wvAGJruZrOcAAfyrIdjs3w3JLt-C5SFfsqeG9q_gIrE-gPYlwNb2Fwi2GwJiQY7FE_4dnHCoay21rZ5slHUy1aVgwDF5R2fV95fBISKAs08tvUSUIE68xT9wfTV1U2pi2Ct_vLS3g0QQ9mer3SM0cBO6IECNmMoKsr5q_ZpjMxUqPWk48aSW68X0rW0tY23gZsFozK8x9nrXc7in42fSmS9v4ejEnb34COtXVHAhcF93fnEWoLXVhogx-vqIINnrGBSsCD3EQahzOprKG-T7WVMfG-0llQwBKH_iDjx7cacT_8Y7Fn9y7N5-xCbMsya6eMeuk1hZmNvHjyskl8AQlqwZUcMLLbNZiIswd9nX-UgrLaSDI0egoyBaTw85mzrRa1VbFXzN6SUhM5W_Qxi690MNkvwtU36yjSy4zT6_aslbcprVtH_CdiB8hgVVs_Sbwq9Ay2pidnXjk5_YKhs%3D)
**The now:** After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations.

**This brings me to my main point:** I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – _except for YOU._

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=999502a38d00467a96c6fbcc728ee402&_e=UB0DEmmkrmf-XbN_JyG2oXa9wvAGJruZrOcAAfyrIdjs3w3JLt-C5SFfsqeG9q_gIrE-gPYlwNb2Fwi2GwJiQY7FE_4dnHCoay21rZ5slHUy1aVgwDF5R2fV95fBISKAs08tvUSUIE68xT9wfTV1U2pi2Ct_vLS3g0QQ9mer3SM0cBO6IECNmMoKsr5q_ZpjMxUqPWk48aSW68X0rW0tY23gZsFozK8x9nrXc7in42fSmS9v4ejEnb34COtXVHAhcF93fnEWoLXVhogx-vqIINnrGBSsCD3EQahzOprKG-T7WVMfG-0llQwBKH_iDjx7cacT_8Y7Fn9y7N5-xCbMs08r3NcyKC1zsM_8fF46Qd4S3k9G3Wm9iZVdeveCBGGPTqFj-AkNPJemc1oFOpK-RoxVCwZTy1w-XvWVJLJa_-xSA9m4McQPJmmva0BU7ebGwLFGP8OOh4fq4Sxla-NKAq70CEc7moxN9mCrbZhoy04%3D)
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

[**I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight with me:**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=999502a38d00467a96c6fbcc728ee402&_e=UB0DEmmkrmf-XbN_JyG2oXa9wvAGJruZrOcAAfyrIdjs3w3JLt-C5SFfsqeG9q_gIrE-gPYlwNb2Fwi2GwJiQY7FE_4dnHCoay21rZ5slHUy1aVgwDF5R2fV95fBISKAs08tvUSUIE68xT9wfTV1U2pi2Ct_vLS3g0QQ9mer3SM0cBO6IECNmMoKsr5q_ZpjMxUqPWk48aSW68X0rW0tY23gZsFozK8x9nrXc7in42fSmS9v4ejEnb34COtXVHAhcF93fnEWoLXVhogx-vqIINnrGBSsCD3EQahzOprKG-T7WVMfG-0llQwBKH_iDjx7cacT_8Y7Fn9y7N5-xCbMs4PPrpAohfbq0TH2csLyJDI5L1ixMWYrQcvWs5CJS9I_2KeeDl5as8OJdiJtyV_NwSrKpujxycQTHQ_95Y37jm-NPzeMwCKtSTLaECKMMXBK0lwxSH_lNcPFm3dgs3Q0mNgB3yMtQvbX6iHt25xCO60%3D)

clean_body: the Five Ws | It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important... The beginning: My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father. This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream. The middle: I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her. Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate: You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree. The now: After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations. This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – except for YOU. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. | Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Dr. Mehmet Oz Dr. Mehmet Oz is a Trump-endorsed, America First Conservative running for U.S. Senate to reignite our divine spark, fight for freedom and return the power to you. to ensure that he has the support he needs to become Pennsylvania’s next Senator. Now, we know you see these kinds of deadlines everywhere, whether that’s from our campaign or others. Oftentimes they’ll share an amount with you that they need to reach with no other context, but I want to make sure you know exactly why we are asking you to give to this campaign. She’s blunt about wanting to bring MAGA influence into our district — and I’m hellbent on making sure that never happens. And because of all that outside support, Monica has loads of big checks in the bank. It’s allowing her to put her name and lies about our campaign all over the district, in person and digitally. That puts our House Majority in jeopardy. Republicans have made it clear that one of their goals this year is to take the House, which would give them all the power to pass laws that will only benefit them and the special interests they are working for. This race is one that could determine whether we can keep the House. And finally, all of these fundraising numbers will be released and made public before the election. Tonight at midnight, we are going to be hitting our August End of Month deadline. Now, we know you see these kinds of deadlines everywhere, whether that’s from our campaign or others. Oftentimes they’ll share an amount with you that they need to reach with no other context, but I want to make sure you know exactly why we are asking you to give to this campaign. Let me break it down with you. This is one of the most competitive races not just in Texas but in the entire country. My opponent has been backed by Trump and many more of his allies. She’s blunt about wanting to bring MAGA influence into our district — and I’m hellbent on making sure that never happens. And because of all that outside support, Monica has loads of big checks in the bank. It’s allowing her to put her name and lies about our campaign all over the district, in person and digitally. That puts our House Majority in jeopardy. Republicans have made it clear that one of their goals this year is to take the House, which would give them all the power to pass laws that will only benefit them and the special interests they are working for. This race is one that could determine whether we can keep the House. And finally, all of these fundraising numbers will be released and made public before the election. I want to make sure our fundraising reflects the energy and momentum we are seeing on the ground here in South Texas — and shows our opponents just how much people-power is coming their way. Here’s the bottom line: what we raise now will determine whether or not we hold our majority in the House and whether South Texans have a representative who will truly fight for them and their families, not alt-right, corporate interests. I want to be that representative. I want to spend my time in Washington to make sure the people of TX-15 are heard. I want to create solutions to the issues my neighbors, friends, and family are dealing with every day. ¡Vamos por Quince! name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: The First Amendment is dead
body:
| | | Peter, What kind of nation would we live in if we couldn't criticize politicians and elected leaders? I'll tell you. **We 'd live in a nation like the Soviet Union, communist China, or North Korea.** One of the greatest freedoms that we as Americans enjoy is the freedom of speech, including the freedom to speak out against leaders and policies we disagree with - all fully protected by the First Amendment. But, as you know, the radical left is doing everything it can to trample those rights. Recently, a leftist district attorney in Massachusetts retaliated against her critic by filing a criminal complaint against him after he publicly questioned the district attorney's incompetency. We're fighting back with a massive new lawsuit - but we need your help urgently. [**Which is why I 'm asking you for an emergency, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to the Center for American Liberty today as we prepare to wade into a legal war to defend the freedom of speech. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61156252:JFPzKoVNj:m:1:3334294963:C23FC5982F249769AAD5973CB34F4FC3:r) You see, last year Joao DePina, a resident of Boston, Massachusetts, publicly questioned then-Suffolk County District Attorney Rachel Rollins about gun violence and the incompetence of her office to respond to his brother's murder. Rollins openly mocked Joao and continued her press conference. But then, just three days later, Rollins caused a criminal complaint to be filed against Joao, accusing him of attorney intimidation. It was crystal clear to anyone looking at the complaint that the charges were a direct violation of Joao's right to free speech and multiple District Attorneys refused to prosecute the case. _**However, the Worcester District Attorney decided to prosecute the case to fullest extent and sought a maximum penalty of 10 years in prison for Joao.**_ Thankfully, a judge ruled in favor of Joao's motion to dismiss the case citing the clear and obvious First Amendment issues. But no punishment or consequences of any kind were given to Rollins or the Worcester County DA for this malicious prosecution of Joao. In fact, Rachel Rollins essentially got a promotion - she's now a U.S. Attorney! **That 's why we're stepping in and suing Rollins and the Worcester DA for malicious prosecution, abuse of process, violation of Joao's freedom of speech, and reckless infliction of emotional distress.** But we can't win without you. [**Will you join this critical fight today with a gift of $35 or more right now?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61156252:JFPzKoVNj:m:1:3334294963:C23FC5982F249769AAD5973CB34F4FC3:r) Because this behavior cannot go unchecked. How can we allow a prosecutor to try to send a citizen to prison just for speaking out against them? That's the kind of thing that happens in China or North Korea. Not here. Not in our Constitutional Republic that was founded on the idea that no man or woman is above the law. **If we cannot peacefully criticize public officials, then the First Amendment is truly dead.** Imagine if Rollins and her cronies are allowed to get away with this. Where will this happen next? Your county? Your state? The federal government?! There must be limitations on the immunity afforded to prosecutors. With your support, we're going to go to the mat fighting to save our Constitution. But we need your help immediately. [**So please, make an urgent donation of $35 or more and help us stop the abuse of power being perpetrated by these leftists.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61156252:JFPzKoVNj:m:1:3334294963:C23FC5982F249769AAD5973CB34F4FC3:r) Please don't hesitate - the battle for your rights is heating up with each passing day. Thank you in advance four your support.
---
Sincerely,

name: Brenda Siegel
subject: Remembering our loved ones
body:
| |
---
Today is National Overdose Awareness Day. **** Today, we remember the victims of the Overdose Crisis and their families. So many families in Vermont and all across the country are suffering. Our children, our loved ones, and our community members are valuable and should be remembered. This day is very hard for me. In March of 2018, my nephew Kaya Siegel died of an overdose after a year in recovery. He was the son of my brother who died just over 20 years before him also while using heroin. With twenty years between them, the supports still did not exist for them to survive in our state.
---
|
---
We are going in the wrong direction in our state and are not doing enough to change it. In 2020, Vermont was number one for percentage increase in overdose deaths in the entire country, and by a lot. In 2021 we were in the top tier for the same, and we saw the most overdose deaths in the history of our state. This administration has presided over the most overdose deaths in the history of our state and he keeps vetoing the bills. **** Today, we should both remember the victims of the crisis and resolve to finally put an end to overdose deaths once and for all. **** The Governor has vetoed multiple comprehensive bills to support the expansion of treatment access and harm reduction solutions. Time and time again the Governor’s budget does not include adequate funding for harm reduction or mental health services, which ties the hands of providers and communities to solve this crisis. **** I’ve released a plan to heal the Overdose Crisis which gained traction across the state and Country. A bill based on that plan was introduced in the State Legislature in 2022. We need to focus on harm reduction first, treatment and recovery on demand, including medically-assisted treatment on demand, dual diagnosis support and criminal justice reform — The Siegel administration will be moving forward to ensure that we are healing the overdose crisis. Thank you for taking the time to remember those we have lost. We can’t let their deaths be in vain. We have no choice but to do better. Our children deserve better.
---
Thank you, Brenda Siegel

It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important...

**The beginning:** My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6321361979384e7cb3657eafdac77252&_e=4ye_LhO9oYxdHGd2AP6Nyht1vHrn7DWaFJZ5YpMkyJi_436u-ZNiU4NdnXTFruncovArjJ2lI80GjPzaEJfpZC3RvVSR9_1uk_l-LfIiF2_ot2BHPEnJY_vB9UafGKZrncvnhyfehZR871CYV_qmF2LDa76iJN9uX63PZyK95FjL3TFsfHK03JGmx4OqvynBxNv45utOw1skr539wdbjLKsoSbcP-4Zci7IxiBV8cKfLilvI8xCpV9rgZNFIPmpUDDE1jfu8rw-pgS8WVIiwe9Cl0qom0JJ6xgP3Odn-R_OuxPVqiNBnVytxFFfoqlPdRI8BC_vYwDSW0Gf0rfY5suY86dK5ZnM05s0N6tdVRuCZ5-KB1os4LrSub05zmOVSO4xbllOZXicjfB9J90nt6aEbskg3IZKqx3uTaGKWkBxDh_4d1f1NksOBaZUxsh2IGXvjO3tyZTiHIVRHAxr5nuw9LH3uNTYRBEkWr29dih8%3D)
This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6321361979384e7cb3657eafdac77252&_e=4ye_LhO9oYxdHGd2AP6Nyht1vHrn7DWaFJZ5YpMkyJi_436u-ZNiU4NdnXTFruncovArjJ2lI80GjPzaEJfpZC3RvVSR9_1uk_l-LfIiF2_ot2BHPEnJY_vB9UafGKZrncvnhyfehZR871CYV_qmF2LDa76iJN9uX63PZyK95FjL3TFsfHK03JGmx4OqvynBxNv45utOw1skr539wdbjLKsoSbcP-4Zci7IxiBV8cKfLilvI8xCpV9rgZNFIPmpUDDE1jfu8rw-pgS8WVIiwe9Cl0qom0JJ6xgP3Odn-R_OuxPVqiNBnVytxFFfoqlPdRI8BC_vYwDSW0Gf0rfY5smDWTT2lmUZnZ_xYG3UOmzh8KbQ43qS6NyW8K-i_z3uDxcVHR1D6PevZ-g8OgDDqOl6EX_pxDpMKLPjeyvzH5kzTCoUWU_7BYj0p7Dnvn12IeQlnUcw7Il8K3TJto3nPg4OgYOC8odlEZimrUqhCENs%3D)
**The middle:** I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6321361979384e7cb3657eafdac77252&_e=4ye_LhO9oYxdHGd2AP6Nyht1vHrn7DWaFJZ5YpMkyJi_436u-ZNiU4NdnXTFruncovArjJ2lI80GjPzaEJfpZC3RvVSR9_1uk_l-LfIiF2_ot2BHPEnJY_vB9UafGKZrncvnhyfehZR871CYV_qmF2LDa76iJN9uX63PZyK95FjL3TFsfHK03JGmx4OqvynBxNv45utOw1skr539wdbjLKsoSbcP-4Zci7IxiBV8cKfLilvI8xCpV9rgZNFIPmpUDDE1jfu8rw-pgS8WVIiwe9Cl0qom0JJ6xgP3Odn-R_OuxPVqiNBnVytxFFfoqlPdRI8BC_vYwDSW0Gf0rfY5su24fodTAGibCsRFsvFvdL96X70U89F-1INlpKslzze4DUNM5-XeVBtjIHyHVH68m-gP_wpAAOhIwX2jG6GRy7OUBYID6T2QJ7NFdbPMhI_65HjvwvGhDT-Be8QNPQDAYKuT6nDFFVAORdUsVF19dds%3D)
Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate:

**You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree.**
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6321361979384e7cb3657eafdac77252&_e=4ye_LhO9oYxdHGd2AP6Nyht1vHrn7DWaFJZ5YpMkyJi_436u-ZNiU4NdnXTFruncovArjJ2lI80GjPzaEJfpZC3RvVSR9_1uk_l-LfIiF2_ot2BHPEnJY_vB9UafGKZrncvnhyfehZR871CYV_qmF2LDa76iJN9uX63PZyK95FjL3TFsfHK03JGmx4OqvynBxNv45utOw1skr539wdbjLKsoSbcP-4Zci7IxiBV8cKfLilvI8xCpV9rgZNFIPmpUDDE1jfu8rw-pgS8WVIiwe9Cl0qom0JJ6xgP3Odn-R_OuxPVqiNBnVytxFFfoqlPdRI8BC_vYwDSW0Gf0rfY5srr-KSk2OEs63rsjzgWDkfTwHZ85If9m2fmPdNOXlwinuLpHnr6lRVBU5K41aYONXzRD6OmFpK-mcE8czeUPulAvL8v3fHmr0DKA9Zelih9HIc6YlluMkIQQxYOIItq7o9vMQhlEP5PYzb6AcwLIU0w%3D)
**The now:** After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations.

**This brings me to my main point:** I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – _except for YOU._

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6321361979384e7cb3657eafdac77252&_e=4ye_LhO9oYxdHGd2AP6Nyht1vHrn7DWaFJZ5YpMkyJi_436u-ZNiU4NdnXTFruncovArjJ2lI80GjPzaEJfpZC3RvVSR9_1uk_l-LfIiF2_ot2BHPEnJY_vB9UafGKZrncvnhyfehZR871CYV_qmF2LDa76iJN9uX63PZyK95FjL3TFsfHK03JGmx4OqvynBxNv45utOw1skr539wdbjLKsoSbcP-4Zci7IxiBV8cKfLilvI8xCpV9rgZNFIPmpUDDE1jfu8rw-pgS8WVIiwe9Cl0qom0JJ6xgP3Odn-R_OuxPVqiNBnVytxFFfoqlPdRI8BC_vYwDSW0Gf0rfY5snWLTZYtEkzUvMSpR7eCPqu6Eqryy_8NjdaEo0eiEzXidQrHGdwVGW2I5vGYuTxuejxDlYaOHX-AKuzyY90TgmcG0PGycgXvGXTe8LUWpLVdwyjCTZ8oVX4UEKxS9fU4L2TanxXtuHb5KCpQOWNDrlA%3D)

clean_body: the Five Ws | It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important... The beginning: My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father. This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream. The middle: I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her. Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate: You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree. The now: After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations. This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – except for YOU. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. | Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Dr. Mehmet Oz Dr. Mehmet Oz is a Trump-endorsed, America First Conservative running for U.S. Senate to reignite our divine spark, fight for freedom and return the power to you. to ensure that he has the support he needs to become Pennsylvania’s next Senator. It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important...

**The beginning:** My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. subject: Good
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Country First
body:
| [ ](http://www.country1st.com/?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_afghan_nd&n=1)
---
Friend -- It's the last day of the month, so you're probably being bombarded with urgent pleas for political cash. That's not what this email is about. With the one year anniversary of the American withdrawal from Afghanistan, I'm reminded of how helpless so many of us felt watching thousands of our Afghan allies being left to the wolves. And in that moment, my team and I decided there _was_ something we could do: mobilize the good, generous people of this movement -- NOT to give more money TO Country First, but THROUGH Country First to wonderful, small organizations working to evacuate and resettle. We called this the Afghan Ally Relief Fund, and it's been a huge success. And then, when Russia brutally attacked Ukraine, our movement mobilized again to support refugees, resettlement, and direct assistance to armed forces on the front lines. We called this the Stand with Ukraine Fund, and again, it's been a huge success. In total, our movement has raised and donated more than $300,000 to worthy charitable causes. Country First has literally saved and rebuilt lives while others just played politics. You've allowed us to be different. Thank you! And sure, you will still get emails from me asking you to [directly support the work of Country First](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_afghan_nd&n=2) (building a movement isn't free), but I hope you know this has never been about the money. It's been about the difference we can make together. And on that note, every time I send an email, without fail, I receive replies from people apologizing for not being able to give more or even give at all. And I will tell you what I tell them: Even if you never give a dollar, you will _always_ have a home in Country First. Moral support is rarer and more valuable to me than any financial contribution could be. So THANK YOU for being here, for the gifts you share with our movement, and for the **good** we're doing in America and the world. I couldn't do this without you -- and I wouldn't want to. Country First, Adam | | [](https://www.country1st.com/get_involved?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_afghan_nd&n=3 "Take Action") [Take Action](https://www.country1st.com/get_involved?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_afghan_nd&n=3)

body:
the Five Ws

| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=485495dcc20546cca88483976cb0d471&_e=Xm-C6sKZqj6UemqXVGeubBYCIGdQiQxWYobdvxIXBY_vw5CiWrjxg4CtsH8RZyX9veqznVunVuYnAL8W0RCQNtDpOyYxRkxuoDH9TEbIMM05VxBa-rhFnLFspmbuXqH0rOxu1Fx-58o3JX-w5SFkZYkpKrbYw3TwDpazu_Bxz-Ni5p_PZAtjpSWgrD5Ly6IXVvybMo0Mbc_2uf7viVmh5c-B_zY0MjGQhBJd0_ijD5G8Eb0D551qQH1QTz8An45Rg1MlDyM2g5bsds8G7QJSUeaTBdDGENs113HWOFy1SJP8iUipj_xFR2QGGL97N1ZgY89x3rn7aYzi0q3OveG9ogG5JeWYPMWPT9I8VOdVx6IdnV8jbfx4dOk8lhjqy15Ak7YtUQMlQ9Mz1ZzroIRxC5zLkiBDbEy9Gh1y16r2i6wdrg7K_7hoc43uaKoBtwJl9zrqHCublLcKLVe19D60iyy729lbRzyS0_P0NnAn-7I%3D)
---
It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important...

**The beginning:** My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=485495dcc20546cca88483976cb0d471&_e=Xm-C6sKZqj6UemqXVGeubBYCIGdQiQxWYobdvxIXBY_vw5CiWrjxg4CtsH8RZyX9veqznVunVuYnAL8W0RCQNtDpOyYxRkxuoDH9TEbIMM05VxBa-rhFnLFspmbuXqH0rOxu1Fx-58o3JX-w5SFkZYkpKrbYw3TwDpazu_Bxz-Ni5p_PZAtjpSWgrD5Ly6IXVvybMo0Mbc_2uf7viVmh5c-B_zY0MjGQhBJd0_ijD5G8Eb0D551qQH1QTz8An45Rg1MlDyM2g5bsds8G7QJSUeaTBdDGENs113HWOFy1SJP8iUipj_xFR2QGGL97N1ZgY89x3rn7aYzi0q3OveG9ohJlk92e8129__suk7qbe5_glC7cqL77lzsOrLnfeERGxV6vz7MSGlgEcmI1kCzQkGVbuzcKHAVgBt1ciJo1piIXXMWT3p4VyVB5el6356g8ar17j1dTe1cLw1IeHNX8mo9BZfIs90b963q_qkPYV9s%3D)
This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=485495dcc20546cca88483976cb0d471&_e=Xm-C6sKZqj6UemqXVGeubBYCIGdQiQxWYobdvxIXBY_vw5CiWrjxg4CtsH8RZyX9veqznVunVuYnAL8W0RCQNtDpOyYxRkxuoDH9TEbIMM05VxBa-rhFnLFspmbuXqH0rOxu1Fx-58o3JX-w5SFkZYkpKrbYw3TwDpazu_Bxz-Ni5p_PZAtjpSWgrD5Ly6IXVvybMo0Mbc_2uf7viVmh5c-B_zY0MjGQhBJd0_ijD5G8Eb0D551qQH1QTz8An45Rg1MlDyM2g5bsds8G7QJSUeaTBdDGENs113HWOFy1SJP8iUipj_xFR2QGGL97N1ZgY89x3rn7aYzi0q3OveG9ooT0v4-g-AZ2YpzWEL2o2QvjPW7BTfnwQdzeqO1nNxB_3lc8XqnkUqCGEacEt1xdKx2phIvE4Pdz3rxj9DMXjJ1bgbqtG-iHTz61LnZyZLVBVQYtBrPf4ZwHNkWjS07eBY-gDLLxGgJokl1akwKBX4k%3D)
**The middle:** I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=485495dcc20546cca88483976cb0d471&_e=Xm-C6sKZqj6UemqXVGeubBYCIGdQiQxWYobdvxIXBY_vw5CiWrjxg4CtsH8RZyX9veqznVunVuYnAL8W0RCQNtDpOyYxRkxuoDH9TEbIMM05VxBa-rhFnLFspmbuXqH0rOxu1Fx-58o3JX-w5SFkZYkpKrbYw3TwDpazu_Bxz-Ni5p_PZAtjpSWgrD5Ly6IXVvybMo0Mbc_2uf7viVmh5c-B_zY0MjGQhBJd0_ijD5G8Eb0D551qQH1QTz8An45Rg1MlDyM2g5bsds8G7QJSUeaTBdDGENs113HWOFy1SJP8iUipj_xFR2QGGL97N1ZgY89x3rn7aYzi0q3OveG9ovmfbaB6y8zxIa0PuovjI7jdY3QkApjzb_usjmRWjhjHALK7LtvWcP25X7IgwHbm-6X0LlUXk3gjH4hymx1QIsCdgUhIqzZ344TxM4l5aekb7L2C3LyxzVZRGDjWMmShOm0WnxyfMzZUtOJMe7OulE8%3D)
Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate:

**You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree.**
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=485495dcc20546cca88483976cb0d471&_e=Xm-C6sKZqj6UemqXVGeubBYCIGdQiQxWYobdvxIXBY_vw5CiWrjxg4CtsH8RZyX9veqznVunVuYnAL8W0RCQNtDpOyYxRkxuoDH9TEbIMM05VxBa-rhFnLFspmbuXqH0rOxu1Fx-58o3JX-w5SFkZYkpKrbYw3TwDpazu_Bxz-Ni5p_PZAtjpSWgrD5Ly6IXVvybMo0Mbc_2uf7viVmh5c-B_zY0MjGQhBJd0_ijD5G8Eb0D551qQH1QTz8An45Rg1MlDyM2g5bsds8G7QJSUeaTBdDGENs113HWOFy1SJP8iUipj_xFR2QGGL97N1ZgY89x3rn7aYzi0q3OveG9orFgdbvQQk-Q13cHMBG1aJMfT-troIXVpP4YT0xAMB_GuuBaxm5NQouAI8VdxBnIakuS-Ig7QcpFQjcG2ESiyzOHvGOWXHW3F-J_AVd_uabxpFiGImbUtSzgNj5GKwsNrrkZ3qijVCIb94al05xPq74%3D)
**The now:** After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations.

**This brings me to my main point:** I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – _except for YOU._

clean_body: the Five Ws | It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important... The beginning: My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. My father grew up dirt poor (literally sleeping on a dirt floor) and loved this country as much as anyone already here. I would later follow in his footsteps as a cardiothoracic surgeon. I owe much of my work ethic and love of medicine to my father. This is a photo of my parents and me at graduation. I couldn’t have asked for a better pair of role models. They came to America for our nation’s incredible education and democracy, and they never wasted a second working to achieve the American Dream. The middle: I met my wife Lisa in Philadelphia while I was attending the University of Pennsylvania. Funny story – I proposed to her on a city street corner, using a tab from a discarded soda can as a makeshift ring. I’m the luckiest man on Earth to call Lisa my wife of 37 years. And even luckier to have four beautiful children with her. Here’s a picture of me during my residency at the Presbyterian Hospital in New York City. Since then, I became a world-class heart surgeon, performing thousands of heart operations and authoring eight New York Times best sellers. I then went on to practice medicine simultaneously on my own TV show, helping millions take control of their own health. Much of what I learned and practiced as a doctor relates directly to why I am running for Senate: You are the key to solving many of your problems. The messages of empowerment, personal responsibility, and freedom, are the values I’m taking with me to my campaign for the U.S. Senate. I’ve seen firsthand the goal of the liberal elites and establishment – to make your life decisions for you - and cancel you if you disagree. The now: After seeing the dysfunction in Washington and across America, I couldn’t be silent. I refuse to allow the system to continue to fail my kids, my grandchildren, and future generations. This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to empower the people of Pennsylvania and improve their lives. No one, including the Washington establishment, knows what’s best for you – except for YOU. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. | Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Dr. Mehmet Oz Dr. Mehmet Oz is a Trump-endorsed, America First Conservative running for U.S. Senate to reignite our divine spark, fight for freedom and return the power to you. to ensure that he has the support he needs to become Pennsylvania’s next Senator. Hello Friend,

I have great news to share with you!

We had a big win for religious liberty in Kentucky!

Thanks to the efforts of Hazlitt Coalition Reps. Matt Locket, Savannah Maddox and Felicia Rabourn, House Bill 43, also known as the "Church is Essential Act," just passed!

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlp38d1bl0a406fvkcnv4ed8i5ia7d1kjk0vp6a8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1h66or1chh2bs)

Friend, our Bill of Rights and Constitution are under attack by abuse of emergency powers.

[_**Help fight to protect our rights with a donation of $25, $50, $100, or any amount. Click here to send your support >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfr95clki094mpr1ida4r582fdbh6hvghvhv4v6o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1h66or1chh2bs)

The government trampled our rights during COVID.

NEVER again will we allow them to shut down churches during declared emergencies.

_" As given to us in the Bill of Rights, every American citizen has the right to practice and exercise their religion. During the COVID-19 pandemic, churches were told they could not meet in person, and if they did, their actions would be reported to the governor. This was a violation of our rights, and it should never happen again. **With this legislation, the government cannot ban churches from meeting in person, and it ensures that every person has the right to practice their religion how they please.** "_ \- Rep. Shane Baker, HB 43 Original Sponsor

State governments are showing themselves as true bulwarks against the tyranny of the federal government.

You can help YAL support liberty legislators on the state level.

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zisgucbsutgv1dakibv473vlbmhuqq8sv4okejb0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1h66or1chh2bs)

YAL is training thousands of pro-liberty candidates and student activists on how to effectively message the ideas of liberty and use the best techniques to win a campaign.

This is Operation Win at the Door. Here's how it works.
* YAL vets legislators and candidates to ensure that they are principled, pro-liberty, with a history that proves they stand up for YOU and YOUR rights.

* Student activists are trained and deployed across the country. They are sent to key districts to knock doors, drop literature, and make phone calls to fight for freedom.

Can I count on you to support the fight for liberty? **Click below to donate.**

---
Fellow Patriot, Xin lỗi - that means sorry in Vietnamese.
Simple words like “sorry” were foreign to me when I came to America.

We were refugees from Communist Vietnam, and this new country was large and unfamiliar - but I knew even as a kid that it was the land of opportunity.
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c32064%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vQqP1%2fwG0rWlVApFBa7MBQ&sysid=1)
---
I couldn’t let the incredible second chance I got in America go to waste. I studied day and night to learn English, and by the time I was 18, I was enrolled in the Naval Academy. _**Only in America could a little boy who didn’t know a word of English grow up to be an officer in the greatest fighting force in the world.**_ I didn’t get this far in life because of government handouts or political correctness. I worked hard, I had faith, and I never doubted that the American Dream was in reach - _and that terrifies Nancy Pelosi._ **I’m not oppressed or in need of the government’s help. I’m an American just like you. And right now, I’m fighting the radical Left to keep that dream alive for generations to come.** **[Nancy Pelosi thinks that all immigrants and minorities are too stupid to succeed without the government holding their hand. I’m living proof that that’s not true. Let’s prove the radical Left wrong. Pitch in now to keep the American Dream alive and take back the House with a conservative majority that NEVER gave up on America.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c32075%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=64sP95BSXy6gvd5udaPmHw&sysid=1)**

Fellow Patriot, [**I urge you, right this second, to sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States to save America**.](http://trk.readactnews._zfuUG5hpNBscPLBg) An army of conservative heroes including **_Mark Levin, Ben Shapiro, Sean Hannity,_** and** _Lt. Col. Allen West_** have joined our movement to call for an Article V Convention of States. [**Just click here to add your name to this national petition. And then PLEASE forward this email to every single person you know.**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
[**Sign The Petition**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
Our nation is spiraling out of control. Debt threatens to cripple our economy. Federal spending has never been higher — nor has our deficit. And the politicians in Washington won't do anything to save us. _In fact, most of them are part of the problem!_ A Convention of States is our only hope. You see, our Founding Fathers were brilliant men. They left an emergency clause in the Constitution in case the federal government got too big and out-of-control. **Article V of the Constitution allows the states to bypass Congress and the President to call a Convention of States to propose amendments to our Constitution that will rein in the federal government.** Well, conservative leaders all across the country — along with over **_FIVE MILLION_** grassroots patriots — believe it is time to invoke Article V and call a Convention of States for the express, _limited_ purpose of imposing fiscal restraints and term limits on Congress and limiting the power, scope, and jurisdiction of the federal government. And I hope you do, too. With the socialists in control in Washington, it's time to take action before it's too late! It's time for "We the People" to use the most powerful weapon in our arsenal - the Constitution - to fight back against Washington's overreach. [**Please sign the National Petition for an Article V Convention of States right now, and please ask everyone you know to do the same.**](http://trk.readactnews.-WTL5gj865XxVqWAI4Sw) Here at Convention of States Action, we are working overtime to convince the required 34 state legislatures to call for an Article V convention to place limits on the power and jurisdiction of the federal government. **We have already passed the COS Resolution through the state legislatures in 19 states, including four since the start of this year alone — bringing us over __HALFWAY__ to calling a Convention of States and taking the power back from the "ruling class" in Washington!** This year alone, the Resolution has passed out of committee in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Iowa, and Kansas — paving the way for the next round of states to pass! With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, _NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. **A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government.** The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. [**Simply click here to sign and we'll deliver it directly to your state legislators, free of charge. This is our best chance to save America from an out-of-control federal government.**](http://trk.readactnews.) Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. [**Please join the fight to call a Convention of States. Sign the petition today, and urge every freedom-loving American to do the same.**](http://trk.readactnews.)

Thank you, and may God bless America! For America, Mark MecklerPresidentConvention of States Action

With dozens of states currently considering the COS Resolution, NOW_ is our window of opportunity to double down and secure the needed victories to cross the finish line! We have a citizen activist army operating in all 50 states, working tirelessly to urge their state legislators to act in accordance with the will of the people and demand that they pass this critically important Resolution. A Convention of States is our only chance to pass important and long overdue measures like a balanced budget amendment, term limits on Congress and the D.C. Swamp, and limits on the scope and jurisdiction of the federal government. The politicians in Washington wouldn't dare limit their own power. Therefore, we the people need to do it! But in order for that to happen, we need millions and millions of patriotic Americans like you to sign this important national petition. We need to show the members of the state legislatures that the American people are ready for a constitutional solution as big as our nation's problems, an Article V Convention of States. Washington won't fix itself. The federal government is too big, and the politicians are too invested in its growth. We the people must take control through our state legislatures. Thank you, and may God bless America! Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You'd think I was crazy. Aren't they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...

>

>

The results speak volumes of this successful formula to make liberty WIN:

YAL's student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

body:
About 30 years ago, I was a little younger, a little less gray, and was a young lieutenant.

| |
---
| | | | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61159684:6LW0ioVUN:m:1:3253819041:C9E2FBB49EBC02C470F29046983F338D:r)
---

About 30 years ago, I was a little younger, a little less gray, and was a young lieutenant.

_**My tank was Bravo 21.**_ My gunner was a young man named Sayed - the best gunner in our platoon.

We were preparing to fight the Soviets during the Cold War and had just finished a training run.

**Remarkably, we had just hit two consecutive moving targets at a distance of little more than a mile. **

I'll tell you. **We 'd live in a nation like the Soviet Union, communist China, or North Korea.** One of the greatest freedoms that we as Americans enjoy is the freedom of speech, including the freedom to speak out against leaders and policies we disagree with - all fully protected by the First Amendment. But, as you know, the radical left is doing everything it can to trample those rights. Recently, a leftist district attorney in Massachusetts retaliated against her critic by filing a criminal complaint against him after he publicly questioned the district attorney's incompetency. We're fighting back with a massive new lawsuit - but we need your help urgently. [**Which is why I 'm asking you for an emergency, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to the Center for American Liberty today as we prepare to wade into a legal war to defend the freedom of speech. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61161210:6NIW7oVNp:m:1:3331421248:A5BA1E73F4D69E57BAF4E5D5B95186A1:r) You see, last year Joao DePina, a resident of Boston, Massachusetts, publicly questioned then-Suffolk County District Attorney Rachel Rollins about gun violence and the incompetence of her office to respond to his brother's murder. Rollins openly mocked Joao and continued her press conference. But then, just three days later, Rollins caused a criminal complaint to be filed against Joao, accusing him of attorney intimidation. It was crystal clear to anyone looking at the complaint that the charges were a direct violation of Joao's right to free speech and multiple District Attorneys refused to prosecute the case. _**However, the Worcester District Attorney decided to prosecute the case to fullest extent and sought a maximum penalty of 10 years in prison for Joao.**_ Thankfully, a judge ruled in favor of Joao's motion to dismiss the case citing the clear and obvious First Amendment issues. But no punishment or consequences of any kind were given to Rollins or the Worcester County DA for this malicious prosecution of Joao. In fact, Rachel Rollins essentially got a promotion - she's now a U.S. Attorney! **That 's why we're stepping in and suing Rollins and the Worcester DA for malicious prosecution, abuse of process, violation of Joao's freedom of speech, and reckless infliction of emotional distress.** But we can't win without you. [**Will you join this critical fight today with a gift of $35 or more right now?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61161210:6NIW7oVNp:m:1:3331421248:A5BA1E73F4D69E57BAF4E5D5B95186A1:r) Because this behavior cannot go unchecked. How can we allow a prosecutor to try to send a citizen to prison just for speaking out against them? That's the kind of thing that happens in China or North Korea. Not here. Not in our Constitutional Republic that was founded on the idea that no man or woman is above the law. **If we cannot peacefully criticize public officials, then the First Amendment is truly dead.** Imagine if Rollins and her cronies are allowed to get away with this. Where will this happen next? Your county? Your state? The federal government?! There must be limitations on the immunity afforded to prosecutors. With your support, we're going to go to the mat fighting to save our Constitution. But we need your help immediately. [**So please, make an urgent donation of $35 or more and help us stop the abuse of power being perpetrated by these leftists.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61161210:6NIW7oVNp:m:1:3331421248:A5BA1E73F4D69E57BAF4E5D5B95186A1:r) Please don't hesitate - the battle for your rights is heating up with each passing day. Thank you in advance four your support.
---
Sincerely,

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6rt37cj3fvf691anf6ppsm67kiurdqtvb31e3fo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1h66pb3cdh2bs)**

---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk65hfpj1vcppjggitm3rn7s8e585pbq2ih48tfg_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1h66pb3cdh2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

Please use this link to get instant access to your free copy of _**[The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjsh3toekecdggsd5a180dol0eukvvtj6mbhvl68_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1h66pb3cdh2bs)**_ today!

Connor Boyack

About 30 years ago, I was a little younger, a little less gray, and was a young lieutenant.

_**My tank was Bravo 21.**_ My gunner was a young man named Sayed - the best gunner in our platoon.

We were preparing to fight the Soviets during the Cold War and had just finished a training run.

**Remarkably, we had just hit two consecutive moving targets at a distance of little more than a mile. **

After accomplishing this remarkable feat, Sayed turned to me and said "Lieutenant, America is awesome".

My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWGp5CKhlN

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWGp5CKhlN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Anti-Americanism has long been evident in higher education. But
recently, it has spread from college campuses to other areas of
American life.

Today it
asserts itself in many forms-including critical race theory-in
our government, in our K-12 schools, in our corporations, in the
media, in sports, and even in our military.

The
recent election in Virginia brought the corruption of American
K-12 education, in particular, to the forefront of our national
conversation.

The
breakdown (especially among younger Americans) of informed
patriotism-without which self-government is impossible-is not
something we can allow to continue.

While
there is reason to remain hopeful, there is much work to be done
to reverse the current trends in the months and years ahead.

Education
is where this attack on America began-and it is the battlefield
on which we must engage the Left in defense of liberty and
limited constitutional government.

Hillsdale
College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades. We
are now determined, with the help of supporters like you, who
agree with Hillsdale's mission, to redouble our efforts at this
crucial time for our nation-no matter the cost.

That's
why we are expanding our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by
Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

You can
support this vital project through this link:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/preserve-freedom-for-future-generations

The
Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching
Millions will give informed patriots across the country the
effective ability to defend liberty through education. And we
need your help.

The
project has three key objectives:

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, our digest of liberty, to
reach millions more Americans.

Increase the number of citizens (especially younger Americans)
enrolling in our free online courses, such as "Constitution 101:
The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope," and our newest course, "American
Citizenship and Its Decline" with Victor Davis Hanson.

Launch additional Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter
schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, our American
classical K-12 curriculum (including the new Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum) to thousands more American teachers and
homeschoolers.

And your
generous support is critical to our success. Here's why...

Hillsdale
College conducts its educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty-as it does all of its work-while refusing to accept one
penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of
federal or state student grants or loans.

So, to
expand this effective program, we will need thousands of gifts
between $25 and $100. This is the range in which most supporters
give. We will also need a significant number of $500 to $1,000
donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

We
urgently need your help.

You can
safely and securely renew your support using this link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60693305:WGp5CKhlN:m:3:2532013465:8780F014C430AA6CD173CFEDBDC618ED:r

As the
forces of anti-Americanism redouble their own efforts to
undermine informed patriotism in our schools and our culture, and
to subvert constitutionalism in our government, we must engage
them ever more aggressively-including on the central battlefield
of education.

That's
why I hope you'll make your most generous gift in this critical
year for America.

Every
dollar you can give will help expand our Project to Defend
Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions in 2022.

Thank you
for your generosity. I hope you'll stand with us. Together, we
will work to preserve freedom for future generations of
Americans.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Hi Friend, I’m Adam Hinojosa, a 4th generation Texan and a successful small businessman. More than that, I am a husband and a father who wants to leave the world better for my children. Caring about local politics has been ingrained in my siblings and I since we were young. We’d write letters asking them why they were running, and many would even meet with us to talk about issues and their solutions. From there, it was yard signs, door knocking, and volunteering our way to a win. It was an incredibly valuable experience and we learned a lot. I’m grateful every day for those lessons in local leadership and how much it matters.
---

| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3f5d597b2475445490effc44dbc07767&_e=r9p44HDEoU68p5_V_wzJo7As9uD43FmNxhi9lqlrNpo9l5byR7fdkkJHEazn7WH1MRAT8hDuf8bYxKOsDobZgc2CHqKTLJNJFvAcmuEaoYlft7hhcnfCWX9zp0-eEl6D6aVTbGAqEis8pUkWoZHA6uNXQL4tvDaJygu4rjMjVyI4ojaEWICC9cH2Wk8HMjDVDfjV7uS656N32HJUgv3DM2DMreMEWg7gAQUd79y7fCsOlMFFtIR74XbnFbAJVDTtGnu8AahzWYUwveF9fXBi7rLj2GM9PeqyoMFuEHTa8EA%3D)

| It was my father who first introduced me to politics, and after he passed our local friends and family encouraged us to get back into political business. I’ve been dismayed with the fraud and corruption we’re seeing locally. When the incumbent Democrat state senator decided to retire after 30 years in office, we decided it was time to run. This is my home. I was born here, live here, as my family has for 4 generations. Our slice of Texas has the southern coast, and the farms and ranches that make up our vast agricultural industry. There’s a lot to love. But we need to take care of it. Many people know Texas as one of the reddest states in the union, a haven for constitutional liberty and conservative values. This sadly isn’t always the case. I come from the largest Democrat stronghold in Texas and I am on a mission to change that. South Texas has been under Democrat control since Reconstruction. Even with the state flipping red in the 1990’s, South Texas has been the lone hold out. For years, Democrats across the country have claimed there was a sleeping giant in Texas–the Hispanic vote. They swore that once Hispanics and Latinos began voting, Texas would be painted blue once and for all, but they were wrong. Just two months ago, Republican Mayra Flores flipped a historically blue district that Joe Biden won by four points. It’s time to finish what she started here in South Texas. My values, the values of my family, and my community, are values of faith, family, hard work, and honesty. We have been sleeping, but we are waking up. Waking up to the truth that our values no longer align with the Democratic party, if they ever did. We are DONE with the corruption of DC and local Democrats. We are DONE with rich liberals assuming they own our votes. We are DONE with their pandering and we are DONE with their party. **That’s why I am running to****flip South Texas RED****for the first time in over 150 years. **
---

| Democrats have controlled South Texas for well over a century and a half. It has gotten us nothing but open borders, rampant poverty, and skyrocketing crime as the cartels use our backyards for human trafficking and our children’s playgrounds for drug deals. A huge part of my district sits along the border. You can see where President Trump’s wall sits unfinished and cartels smuggle drugs and human victims on a daily basis. Stopping the border crisis and the crime that comes with it is a top priority for me. Enough is enough. Stand with me and help me take the last Democrat stronghold in Texas. | Donald J. Trump, the 45th President of the United States, will join Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen for a pre-primary tele-rally on Monday, September 5 at 7pm.
As announced by senior strategist Corey R. Lewandowski on The Kuhner Report earlier this morning, voters will be able to call (508) 691-7880 and hear President Trump live as he offers his assessment of the race for Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Massachusetts. Diehl, Allen, and Lewandowski will participate in the tele-rally along with President Trump.
President Trump endorsed Geoff Diehl's candidacy for Governor of Massachusetts in late 2021. Geoff Diehl and Leah Allen are running together as a ticket for Governor and Lieutenant Governor.
"I am honored to have the support of our former President heading into the primary on Tuesday, and I am doubly honored to have President Trump's help rallying Massachusetts voters," Diehl said. "This event will give us an excellent opportunity to reaffirm what's important to us in this race, particularly issues of freedom, fiscal responsibility, public safety, and empowering parents to protect their kids. I look forward to a lively discussion about our state and what the Diehl-Allen administration plans to accomplish."
Further details about how to participate in the tele-rally with President Trump will be forthcoming on the Diehl campaign website, www.GeoffDiehl.com, and on his campaign's social media channels (Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram: @DiehlforMA).

Vikram shared why he is different than the other candidates in the race. As a self-described "global trend watcher", Vikram will bring a unique set of skills to Washington to tackle the issues of the day. We continue to send career politicians to serve us, and we continue to see the same negative results. Vikram is confident that his outsider perspective is exactly what this country needs to turn our economy around and stop the identity politics that is tearing us apart.

Thank you, Derek!

Because of grassroots supporters like you who show up and power this campaign, **we reached our August fundraising goal.** We couldn't be more grateful for your very enthusiastic and generous support.
With September now upon us and two months until the election, we're entering crunch time. House Majority Leader Kevin McCarthy says PA-06 is a TOP target for the GOP. Our opponent and his allies are doing everything they can to flip Chrissy's seat. But we know that with this team, we can win if we continue to work together.
Chrissy has never stopped fighting for PA-06 in Congress, and she has no plans of slowing down now. Working families deserve the chance to thrive, and that's why Chrissy voted for the Inflation Reduction Act. It is the most comprehensive bill that will lower energy costs, create jobs in clean energy, help small businesses save money, and lower prescription and health care costs. We all deserve fundamental freedoms, so Chrissy continues to fight to codify Roe.
We are full steam ahead to keep PA-06 blue and Chrissy fighting for us in Congress, and we are so grateful to have you on the team.
There is work to be done!

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: This is what they think of you
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f411b11fbe3ee7c4ba8b1f8868cb2a379b542a1442cb3a7e51d486e554a8109696bd512406a7e08454ab46cf65a1eccfcf2c978e289a4527330c6738976ebf404f4a0fec25ae86f3d0f809ea5762fe61

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=07667b5dd4f36a23f1f65104fb4fd797969f3f14a02034dde1066cc09aceeff3a8d5c4c7c1ea77fcc6fc549e256258e4a47b36137c158c9b3403b6068047dc25

Peter,

Florida Democrats and the far Left's message to more than half of the American public is simple: they hate you. They think you are second-class citizens just because you don’t think like they do.

Within the past week, we’ve seen Democrats across the nation single out and insult conservatives just for sharing a different viewpoint.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=07667b5dd4f36a23f1f65104fb4fd797969f3f14a02034dde1066cc09aceeff3a8d5c4c7c1ea77fcc6fc549e256258e4a47b36137c158c9b3403b6068047dc25
>>>">Stand up to Democrats’ hate and division! >>>

New York’s governor told 5.4 million Republican citizens they don’t belong and to pack up and leave the state because they “are not New Yorkers.”

My opponent here in Florida told anyone who supports me that he doesn’t want your vote because you have “hate in your heart.”

And Brandon – who declared at the start of his administration he was going to unify the nation – is now declaring conservative values as “semi-fascist.”

For all they claim to be, the party of “unity and decency” does seem to think they’re better than you.

That’s the crux of it, Peter.

They’re not looking to unify our state or nation. They’re not looking to spread decency and kindness.

They’re looking to create a Florida for those who follow their radical thinking and will help push their woke agenda onto others.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=07667b5dd4f36a23f1f65104fb4fd797969f3f14a02034dde1066cc09aceeff3a8d5c4c7c1ea77fcc6fc549e256258e4a47b36137c158c9b3403b6068047dc25
>>>">Reject the Left’s elitism! >>>

That is the Left’s plan for 2022. Divide the nation into two classes: those who are with them and those who are not.

We’ve already seen this threat on a larger scale with the weaponization of federal agencies like the DOJ, the IRS, and the FBI.

Those 87,000 new IRS agents aren’t being brought on to audit the liberal elite. They’re going to be used to target the middle class.

Student loan “forgiveness” isn’t going to benefit the everyday American. That debt is being transferred from a gender studies major onto Americans who either elected not to go to college or those who worked hard to pay off their debt.

It’s unfair to force a truck driver to pay a loan for someone who got a Ph.D. in gender studies.

They’re not worried about how this is going to affect you, Peter, because they are not worried about you at all.

They’re worried about themselves and bolstering their radical agenda. They’ll give favor to those who get in line and they will go after those who do not.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=07667b5dd4f36a23f1f65104fb4fd797969f3f14a02034dde1066cc09aceeff3a8d5c4c7c1ea77fcc6fc549e256258e4a47b36137c158c9b3403b6068047dc25
>>>">Stand with me against the Left’s schemes. >>>

Well, I'm standing in their way from injecting their woke agenda into our state and they can't stand it. Their attacks on us are only just beginning, and we must build a firewall for freedom fighters everywhere.

I’m continuing full speed ahead in my battle to Keep Florida Free. I need to know that I have your support.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=07667b5dd4f36a23f1f65104fb4fd797969f3f14a02034dde1066cc09aceeff3a8d5c4c7c1ea77fcc6fc549e256258e4a47b36137c158c9b3403b6068047dc25
>>>">Can I count on you to join me in the fight? >>>

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=07667b5dd4f36a23f1f65104fb4fd797969f3f14a02034dde1066cc09aceeff3a8d5c4c7c1ea77fcc6fc549e256258e4a47b36137c158c9b3403b6068047dc25

Talk soon,

Josh

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/AndysFightLogo.PNG][https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95557/images/IMG_9106%20copy.jpeg]
Hi Peter,
This week President Biden made it clear he wasn’t going to give up on an assault weapons ban [https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/3621471-biden-makes-plea-for-assault-weapon-ban-what-the-hells-the-matter-with-us/] . He was adamant saying, “It’s time to hold every elected official’s feet to the fire and ask them, 'Are you for banning assault weapons? Yes or no?' Ask them,” Biden said. “If the answer’s no, vote against them.”
Yup. But now we have another problem Congress must address. And it’s once again related to social media and the abuse that occurs online. I’m talking about the widespread availability of inexpensive so-called conversion devices -- known as "auto switches" or "auto sears" [https://www.thetrace.org/2022/03/auto-sear-gun-chip-glock-switch-automatic-conversion/] -- capable of transforming semi-automatic weapons into machine guns in a matter of moments. Recently, Houston police officer William "Bill" Jeffrey, a 30-year-veteran, died in a torrent of gunfire [https://abc13.com/deon-ledet-william-bill-jeffrey-hpd-officer-killed-shot-to-death/11118157/] from a criminal armed with an illegally converted weapon.
Availability of auto switches has been driven in part by the ease with which they can be made using cheap, 3D-printed parts and instructions available online . A CNN review of YouTube based on key-word search terms revealed multiple videos that had collectively racked up more than 1 million views. One group of auto-switch instructional videos that remained online until August were linked to a man charged in December by federal prosecutors in Texas for allegedly making, possessing and transferring 3D-printed switches.
In keeping with their typical MO, a company spokesperson said YouTube does not allow "content instructing viewers how to manufacture accessories that convert a firearm to automatic fire, or to sell those accessories on our platform.”

body:
Derek,
I know that in a neck-and-neck race like this one, it's easy to focus solely on things like the latest polling numbers or the day's fundraising goal. So I want to quickly explain exactly what we're fighting for – and why winning here in Georgia matters so much.
Our movement is about building a better, brighter future for all. It's about ensuring that everyone has an equal voice in our government – and a fair shot at the American dream.
That means defending and expanding our constitutional right to vote. It means protecting reproductive freedom nationwide. It means making health care more affordable, bringing economic justice to our communities, and lowering the everyday costs that make it difficult for too many families to make ends meet.
Friend, our movement is about you – your priorities, your concerns, your hopes for the future. That's why it's so important to have you by my side for the critical fights ahead – fights we can only win if we win this election first.

This campaign is fueled entirely by grassroots support, without a cent from corporate PACs.
