subject: Mary Peltola now has ~2 months to work on the general election challenge for the congressional seat she just won in Alaska’s special election. Let’s celebrate this win, and help this seasoned state legislator pivot to face the next contest with vigor, enthusiasm, and solid popular support.
body:

| | |

| | | | | Peter _**,**_ She. Did. It. Mary Peltola, a seasoned state legislator and proven campaigner, BEAT Sarah Palin in an incredible upset in this week’s special election. We told you we believed this great candidate could become the first Alaska Native to win an election to Congress, and she did it!! **Peltola's great campaign--including steadfast support for a women's right to choose, fighting to protect Alaska's natural resources and standing up for Alaskan workers--got it done by 3%, 51.5%-48.5%. The toxic, nasty, right wing zealotry of Palin was also helpful in sealing her fate.** So we have good news and bad news. The bad news is that this was a special election for the seat left open when Rep. Don Young passed away, and there will be a repeat in November. The good news, we have an extra Democratic seat in Congress for those few months, Peltola will be an incumbent when she runs in November and she'll benefit from taking on the toxic Palin yet again.

body:
To the Subscribers of Freedom Nation Today,

Many of our readers have expressed interest in the services offered by Dr. Chad Walding. We hope you benefit from the following message:
---

Is calcium actually good for your bone health? Bad news... In one of the largest bone health studies ever, women who took calcium and vitamin D every day were **no less likely** to break their hips... Hello,
Growing up in rural Iowa, I thought we were well-to-do because we had a piano, a well-used sewing machine, a big garden, and a flag pole. Our house was small, one bathroom, for a family of ten. I was surprised to know that not every family struggled with affording the $7 meal ticket each kid needed for school.
Lebanon, Iowa, had eight houses, a church, and a small feed store. My life centered on helping my dad, school, and exploring Dry Creek, a wonderland of aquatic life down the hill. The nearest town was Hudson, SD, nine miles west down a gravel road.
We were the prototypical rural Iowa family. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, lunch, then supper kept the house full of aromas. “Read a book,” would be mom’s terse direction if you showed any idleness. It is from this humble beginning, work as a welder, farmhand, then in a slaughterhouse, that brought me into the U.S. Navy.
America must present an opportunity for its citizens to achieve great things. From homemade clothes (I’m the littlest one) to a three-star Admiral is just one such journey. The next step is to use life’s experiences to continue a lifetime of service to this nation and my state of Iowa.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa because I can represent people from all walks of life. My life’s experiences provided an innate understanding for what it means to be a Democrat:_to care as much for those I’ve never met as I do for those I know_. Obviously, Chuck Grassley is not a Democrat; he seems to only care about what Trump and his corporate PAC donors want.**
People like me aren’t supposed to be able to run and win. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are already raising millions from corporate special interests to try to make sure I don’t.
If there’s one thing I’ve learned in life, though, it’s that anything is possible when a group of people work together to make it happen. I’m not taking one dime from corporate PACs; instead, I’m running my campaign entirely with support from over 135,000 grassroots donors like you.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: The First Amendment is dead
body:
What kind of nation would we live in if we couldn’t criticize politicians and elected leaders?
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfrr8egenhg7tiuioo11pg6nck13oh0rehi01qe0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1gm6oj5cth238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfbd9im5jb2dj5m6or6pjmc4q3cd9mc5o62cdgekp66sdjchhmcs356hi6cshicsrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj1cr0cup3cphksiqradtgmlin49fg)
| | | Friend, What kind of nation would we live in if we couldn’t criticize politicians and elected leaders? I’ll tell you. **We’d live in a nation like the Soviet Union, communist China, or North Korea.** One of the greatest freedoms that we as Americans enjoy is the freedom of speech, including the freedom to speak out against leaders and policies we disagree with – all fully protected by the First Amendment. But, as you know, the radical left is doing everything it can to trample those rights. Recently, a leftist district attorney in Massachusetts retaliated against her critic by filing a criminal complaint against him after he publicly questioned the district attorney’s incompetency. We’re fighting back with a massive new lawsuit – but we need your help urgently. [**Which is why I’m asking you for an emergency, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to the Center for American Liberty today as we prepare to wade into a legal war to defend the freedom of speech.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3s1mrld960b0k5halh256dsuvras6rv084vg090_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1gm6oj5cth2bs) You see, last year Joao DePina, a resident of Boston, Massachusetts, publicly questioned then-Suffolk County District Attorney Rachel Rollins about gun violence and the incompetence of her office to respond to his brother’s murder. Rollins openly mocked Joao and continued her press conference. But then, just three days later, Rollins caused a criminal complaint to be filed against Joao, accusing him of attorney intimidation. It was crystal clear to anyone looking at the complaint that the charges were a direct violation of Joao’s right to free speech and multiple District Attorneys refused to prosecute the case. _**However, the Worcester District Attorney decided to prosecute the case to fullest extent and sought a maximum penalty of 10 years in prison for Joao.**_ Thankfully, a judge ruled in favor of Joao’s motion to dismiss the case citing the clear and obvious First Amendment issues. But no punishment or consequences of any kind were given to Rollins or the Worcester County DA for this malicious prosecution of Joao. In fact, Rachel Rollins essentially got a promotion – she’s now a U.S. Attorney! **That’s why we’re stepping in and suing Rollins and the Worcester DA for malicious prosecution, abuse of process, violation of Joao’s freedom of speech, and reckless infliction of emotional distress.** But we can’t win without you. [**Will you join this critical fight today with a gift of $35 or more right now?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4njjkfo9dog4qhqjaf2ne3ijb082q1hine94ko8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1gm6oj5cth2bs) Because this behavior cannot go unchecked. How can we allow a prosecutor to try to send a citizen to prison just for speaking out against them? That’s the kind of thing that happens in China or North Korea. Not here. Not in our Constitutional Republic that was founded on the idea that no man or woman is above the law. **If we cannot peacefully criticize public officials, then the First Amendment is truly dead.** Imagine if Rollins and her cronies are allowed to get away with this. Where will this happen next? Your county? Your state? The federal government?! There must be limitations on the immunity afforded to prosecutors. With your support, we’re going to go to the mat fighting to save our Constitution. But we need your help immediately. [**So please, make an urgent donation of $35 or more and help us stop the abuse of power being perpetrated by these leftists.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv4a0b482aulc47urmqjdiqjsn77c2vngv430b7o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1gm6oj5cth2bs) Please don’t hesitate – the battle for your rights is heating up with each passing day. Thank you in advance four your support.
---
Sincerely,

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Congressman Jim Banks Endorses Erik Aadland
body:
| | | |
---
---
| Congressman Jim Banks Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(September 1, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Congressman Jim Banks.
Congressman Jim Banks is a native Hoosier, born and raised in Columbia City, Indiana. Banks earned an undergraduate degree from Indiana University and a Master of Business Administration from Grace College. While serving in the Indiana State Senate from 2010 to 2016, he chaired the Senate Veteran Affairs and the Military Committee where he led the charge on many significant pro-growth, pro-family, and pro-veteran reforms.

Banks was elected in 2016 to represent Indiana's 3rd Congressional District and currently serves as chairman of the Republican Study Committee for the 117th Congress. Banks serves as a member of the House Committee on Armed Services, the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs, and the House Committee on Education and Labor. Additionally, he serves as the Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Subcommittee Cyber, Innovative Technologies, and Information Systems, co-chairs the House Armed Services Committee's Future of Defense Task Force and sits on the Naval Academy's Board of Visitors.

Amid Congressman Banks' work as a public servant, he has been recognized for outstanding service and leadership. In 2018 and 2019, Congressman Banks received the Family Research Council's "True Blue" award for his pro-family voting record. He has also received NFIB's "Guardian of Small Business" award and the FreedomFighter Award from FreedomWorks in recognition of his dedication to economic freedom and personal liberty.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Congressman Banks said:
"I am pleased to endorse my friend and fellow Afghanistan veteran Erik Aadland for Congress in Colorado's 7th district. As a member of the House Committees on Armed Services and Veterans Affairs, I have the utmost confidence that Erik will be an effective advocate for our veterans and service members at home and abroad. Erik is a proven leader in business and in the military. Erik's business experience has taught him the importance of fiscal discipline and we need his help to balance the budget and restore America's fiscal and economic health. Erik is the proven leader we need in Washington, and he has my full support."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I deeply appreciate Congressman Banks's endorsement, a fellow veteran and advocate for veterans, particularly since he is both an astute foreign policy realist and a tireless advocate for his constituents. His personal approach to congressional representation is refreshing in our increasingly anonymous world. I find it to be both a great encouragement and an excellent example for my own efforts. I look forward to working with Congressman Banks on both domestic and international issues."
---

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

clean_body: | | | | | Congressman Jim Banks Endorsement | | | | ---|--- | (September 1, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Congressman Jim Banks. Congressman Jim Banks is a native Hoosier, born and raised in Columbia City, Indiana. Banks earned an undergraduate degree from Indiana University and a Master of Business Administration from Grace College. While serving in the Indiana State Senate from 2010 to 2016, he chaired the Senate Veteran Affairs and the Military Committee where he led the charge on many significant pro-growth, pro-family, and pro-veteran reforms. Banks was elected in 2016 to represent Indiana's 3rd Congressional District and currently serves as chairman of the Republican Study Committee for the 117th Congress. Banks serves as a member of the House Committee on Armed Services, the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs, and the House Committee on Education and Labor. Additionally, he serves as the Ranking Member of the House Armed Services Subcommittee Cyber, Innovative Technologies, and Information Systems, co-chairs the House Armed Services Committee's Future of Defense Task Force and sits on the Naval Academy's Board of Visitors. Amid Congressman Banks' work as a public servant, he has been recognized for outstanding service and leadership. In 2018 and 2019, Congressman Banks received the Family Research Council's "True Blue" award for his pro-family voting record. He has also received NFIB's "Guardian of Small Business" award and the FreedomFighter Award from FreedomWorks in recognition of his dedication to economic freedom and personal liberty. | In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Congressman Banks said: "I am pleased to endorse my friend and fellow Afghanistan veteran Erik Aadland for Congress in Colorado's 7th district. As a member of the House Committees on Armed Services and Veterans Affairs, I have the utmost confidence that Erik will be an effective advocate for our veterans and service members at home and abroad. Erik is a proven leader in business and in the military. Erik's business experience has taught him the importance of fiscal discipline and we need his help to balance the budget and restore America's fiscal and economic health. Erik is the proven leader we need in Washington, and he has my full support." | | | Erik's Remarks | | | | "I deeply appreciate Congressman Banks's endorsement, a fellow veteran and advocate for veterans, particularly since he is both an astute foreign policy realist and a tireless advocate for his constituents. His personal approach to congressional representation is refreshing in our increasingly anonymous world. I find it to be both a great encouragement and an excellent example for my own efforts. I look forward to working with Congressman Banks on both domestic and international issues." | | | | == | | | About Erik | | | Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children. | About Aadland For Congress | | | Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors. You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. name: Mark Dubois
subject: Keeping the Republic
body:
Keeping the Republic by Mark DuboisOn September 17, 1787, the last day of the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia, Benjamin Franklin was reportedly asked what kind of government we now had. | |
---

| | | Keeping the Republic |
---|---|---
| by Mark DuboisOn September 17, 1787, the last day of the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia, Benjamin Franklin was reportedly asked what kind of government we now had. His reply was "A republic, if you can keep it." Surely in that statement Dr. Franklin indicated a deep understanding that "...secur(ing) the Blessings of Liberty to ourselves and our Posterity..." would require that each generation of Americans study, understand, appreciate and defend this new Constitution, and pass along its immense importance to the next. As with any organization that a fallen man establishes, there will be drift if a commitment to remain faithful to written core principles is not diligently maintained. The Founders exercised Godly wisdom in giving this new national government a very limited number of "enumerated powers," and declaring in Article 10 of the Bill of Rights that "The powers not delegated to the United States by the Constitution, nor prohibited by it to the States, are reserved to the States respectively, or to the people." Our current condition is far removed from that design, as evidenced by the immense size and overreach of the national government; and also by the erosion of, and continual attacks on, our God-given, Constitutionally-protected rights. There are well over 200 federal agencies (no one seems to know the exact number) to which Congress has given authority to make rules that have the force of law. Our Second Amendment rights have recently been under attack again by Congress itself. And some on the left have even started openly calling for elimination of the Constitution altogether. But there are signs of hope. Thanks to the conservative shift in the U.S. Supreme Court a few years ago, the latest session saw the removal of the federal government's illegitimate authority over the states on the issue of abortion, the reigning in of some of the Environmental Protection Agency's onerous "rules," reaffirming religious freedom protections under the First Amendment, and confirming that the Second Amendment does indeed protect an individual right ..."to keep and bear arms." And momentum is building at the state level to eliminate other restrictions wrongly imposed by the federal government. So let's do our part to continue the restoration of the proper Constitutional order. Deepen your knowledge of the history and meaning of the Constitution - I recommend Hillsdale College's Constitution courses, available for no cost on its website. Contact elected representatives to express appreciation or concerns. Support organizations and candidates with proven Constitutional conservative track records. Vote in every election. Pass along to the next generations what a blessing from God this nation and the Constitution have been to its citizens and the world (it shouldn't be a mystery why so many people from other nations want to come to America). And most importantly, pray for God's continued blessing on our nation and for wisdom in doing our part to preserve what He has given us. The Founders understood that power needed to be kept as near to the people's control as possible, and that forming a constitutional, representative republic was the best way to accomplish that. They formed the republic - we must continuously work if we are to keep it! |
| |
---|---|---
| |
---
Mark DuBois is a Captain for a major airline. He is a life-long resident of Mississippi, graduating from Southaven High School and Mississippi State University, where he earned B.S. and M.S. degrees in Aerospace Engineering. He was commissioned as an officer through Air Force ROTC at MSU and then spent 9 years as an Air Force pilot. He has been married for 34 years to his high school sweetheart, Michele. They have four adult children. Mark serves as a member of the Mississippi Freedom Caucus steering committee.

body:
| | | |
---
| Friends,
I'm tired of hearing the lies and rhetoric swirling around about debates in this race. We have a primary on Tuesday. It's time to set the record straight.
After the Republican Convention on May 21 and as our party's endorsed candidate, [I challenged Chris Doughty to two debates](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xiTGGCseIYdVhaizvXQPn7ZRvRtQxSwLp0IWhzV2yA1_0Yygg_2zSmlmFO7iWqz470tH3L6ea5KJI9og2wpd57OnUrICML_xnsRTX3Xv0HKRYgLBSSQe5gXyuexwlBkANTYWXYr5z7Hr4noqeU3Zih4A_y6MlX3j3uR_a8v_ZswAn_glvO5wOJkOLhxk_HVG0wzP7tj7ZLAC1AibmnoIvI-pOfMnTy8V6HkqIwg7uwNr1k3VS1SEkg==&c=P5htCLbLNCeKGmiNhsb9gA3N_PKAkuM0nLkqo9NDwl52qiGLshxeYw==&ch=WODb2lx_TJYHK2oBuV0wI1RUHcX-iZH4WEgq0L-dRRN0eQo_zPDU4Q==): one on Howie Carr's Show, and one on Jeff Kuhner's show. I'm a conservative candidate running in a Republican primary, so I wanted primary debates moderated exclusively by conservative voices so voters could hear what each of us really has to say.
My opponent agreed to only one of those debates. Just one.
The two of us sat down live on Howie Carr's show on July 20. Howie Carr and my opponent had a full hour to ask me anything they wanted to, and I answered every question. If you want to see it, here's the picture and the link to watch the full video. (Note, Howie Carr's logo has been removed in this photo at the request of his show, they take substantial advertising revenue from my opponent.)
---
---
| [Watch the Diehl-Doughty Debate](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xiTGGCseIYdVhaizvXQPn7ZRvRtQxSwLp0IWhzV2yA1_0Yygg_2zSmlmFO7iWqz4gxqTVZI64wISkQlRq6kPCq1uvQappcuT1F8Zf1ktOZBeBW77OakGd5weoESF7D11d5NlvFvwLuzEYp4rNUYdFlDgYAGPXvDT2LUgx3OQbjchB4emxTRXEcUshdqUk61-fyL1cvcmy0WY4RGOI27W0KiVY2zJDq0d&c=P5htCLbLNCeKGmiNhsb9gA3N_PKAkuM0nLkqo9NDwl52qiGLshxeYw==&ch=WODb2lx_TJYHK2oBuV0wI1RUHcX-iZH4WEgq0L-dRRN0eQo_zPDU4Q==)
---
My opponent declined to debate on The Kuhner Report. He refused to show up.
I honored my commitment and I appeared alone in-studio on August 11, taking questions from Jeff Kuhner and callers for more than an hour. If you're interested, here is the photo from that debate (no Photoshop; we didn't have to remove my opponent because he wasn't there in the first place) and the link for you to listen:
---
---
| [Listen to Geoff on The Kuhner Report](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xiTGGCseIYdVhaizvXQPn7ZRvRtQxSwLp0IWhzV2yA1_0Yygg_2zSmsF0ItUjGKy9t5TsUs270a0WmbxfJNOflevdyEY6KoNSQCZd2rYZD-GaZM88-KvOVNqbIGnbVq36_JBVT0ufRiowNKXWOXd3v-oD5RSWrjETdstf9ahd__elaXUlVtWdY4oVk9nNUt3MaKklwbytdTJ26TKxJaKOyFcuI0jRD54cVATBiC_9b-iFeeaN5L34-gp6t2tR33Pol8HkhBCts7Q9lSfpjSqQ5iu8mvZ7MeB&c=P5htCLbLNCeKGmiNhsb9gA3N_PKAkuM0nLkqo9NDwl52qiGLshxeYw==&ch=WODb2lx_TJYHK2oBuV0wI1RUHcX-iZH4WEgq0L-dRRN0eQo_zPDU4Q==)
---
After all of this, what does Jeff Kuhner have to say about my opponent and his campaign? Don't take my word for it, you be the judge. Please listen to the audio clip below:
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xiTGGCseIYdVhaizvXQPn7ZRvRtQxSwLp0IWhzV2yA1_0Yygg_2zSmlmFO7iWqz4WNA2i04WtNrkD1bthdC9bkYFbauZO7juDm0c7nU4F4O4kR9l2kQCS56Po5wZ75OEFZ_MxJwMiKLh_wMjGgnV6g==&c=P5htCLbLNCeKGmiNhsb9gA3N_PKAkuM0nLkqo9NDwl52qiGLshxeYw==&ch=WODb2lx_TJYHK2oBuV0wI1RUHcX-iZH4WEgq0L-dRRN0eQo_zPDU4Q==)
---

Here's the only truth you need to know: as our party's endorsed candidate, I challenged my opponent to two debates. He accepted one and declined one. If he now regrets that and has to beg for more time to get his message out before Tuesday's primary, that's not my problem. I'm focused on winning the primary on Tuesday and I'm looking forward to more debates - against Maura Healey this fall.

name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: Fighting for Georgia's Working Families
body:
|
---
Hi Neighbor,

I want to share some exciting news with you about legislation I have been championing in Washington.

I am thrilled that earlier this month, on August 16, 2022, the President signed into law historic legislation that invests in our country's future by lowering costs for Georgians, creating clean energy jobs, and reducing the deficit all at the same time. The Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) will make real change in Georgian's lives. I am especially proud that this legislation includes several proposals I fought for, including provisions that will lower prescription drug costs for seniors. The IRA will uplift Georgia's working families, and I am excited to share some details of this landmark legislation with you. I have heard from countless Georgians about the importance of strengthening and improving our nation's health care system. That is why I am proud that I was able to secure my legislation, S. 4011, the Capping Drug Costs for Seniors Act, in the IRA. This legislation, which caps the annual out-of-pocket costs for people on Medicare Part D at $2,000, will make a meaningful difference in the lives of seniors in every corner of our state.

While I am deeply disappointed that my colleagues across the aisle blocked a $35 per month cap on insulin for patients with private insurance, I am glad the IRA also includes a provision from S. 3700, my Affordable Insulin Now Act, to cap the out-of-pocket costs for insulin at $35 per month for patients covered by Medicare. Know that I will keep fighting to lower insulin costs for all Georgians who need it to survive.

The IRA includes other critical provisions to lower health care costs, including extending premium Affordable Care Act tax credits through 2025, empowering Medicare to begin negotiating directly for lower prescription drug prices, and ensuring that all vaccinations are free for seniors. Know that I will continue working to lower the cost of health care because Georgians should never have to choose between paying for life's basic essentials or life-saving health care services.

I am also glad that this law invests in our future by providing incentives to bolster job-creating clean energy initiatives. In Georgia, this legislation will boost our state's solar manufacturing industry and create jobs through the inclusion of clean energy tax credits. I was especially proud to secure provisions from my bill, S. 2140, the Solar Energy Manufacturing for America Act, in the final legislation. I look forward to Georgia continuing to grow as a national leader in clean energy jobs. And, I believe our farmers, forest landowners, and rural and coastal communities can't be left out of our efforts to green our economy. That is why I was excited to see that this transformative law includes over $20 billion for climate-smart agriculture, $5 billion to improve forest health, $14 billion for rural utility companies to transition to renewable energy, and $2.6 billion for coastal resiliency efforts.

Finally, the IRA will result in historic deficit reduction and provide a massive down payment towards the national debt. I continue to oppose new taxes on working- and middle-class Georgians and small businesses, which is why I am encouraged that the legislation is able to tackle our national debt while ensuring that no families making less than $400,000 or small businesses will see their tax burden increase.

Know that I will continue working in Washington to uplift working Georgia families, and I look forward to working with federal agencies, state and local governments, and Georgia industries to implement the Inflation Reduction Act. Please do not hesitate to contact me if I may ever be of assistance to you or your family.

Keep the faith, and keep looking up.
U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

Peter, I’m proud to report that we’re gaining momentum! Yesterday we faced our end of month fundraising deadline, and we met our goals! We received more contributions this month than any month before, setting a new record. We're killing it. I can’t thank you enough. Our campaign keeps moving along, and I’m proud of what we’ve done so far!
---
|
---

We've been able to build a successful campaign fueled by the grassroots, not corporations or the ultra wealthy. **We got this.** Our campaign is out every day meeting voters and spreading word of our messages of service and community. Folks of all political affiliations and stripes are joining our movement because they know that our ideas are better than Max Miller’s. Again, thank you for everything you've done for us. I know that we'll be able to keep this momentum going and defeat Max Miller this November.

body:
We met our August goal, and I have you to thank. Our grassroots donors powered us across the finish line last night.

Thank you.

Once again, this campaign has shown that – even though it's often threatened – our democracy still has so much strength and promise.

You know as well as I do that progress doesn't just happen with time. Instead, it requires the hard work of folks coming together to push forward for the common good – again and again.

This is what democracy is all about.

Every election, from the city council to Congress, is an important opportunity for progress.

It's not always easy. Corporate special interests and Republican leadership not only resist any step forward – on climate change, on prescription drug prices, on abortion access, on relief for working families, even on anti-corruption efforts – they're actively working to undo progress and move us backward.

Our democracy depends on people like you and me showing up, day after day, to advocate for what is right. I'm constantly humbled by the number of people joining us in this fight.

Again I can't thank you enough for your continued support. This race won't be easy, but together, I know we can triumph over those who would turn the clock back.

Andy

This is what democracy is all about. Every election, from the city council to Congress, is an important opportunity for progress. It's not always easy. Corporate special interests and Republican leadership not only resist any step forward – on climate change, on prescription drug prices, on abortion access, on relief for working families, even on anti-corruption efforts – they're actively working to undo progress and move us backward. body:
I'm with Pramila because she's a leader who always puts the people first.
#
Hey Peter, it’s actor and advocate Mark Ruffalo.
I wanted you to be one of the first to know that I’ll be joining Pramila Jayapal for her annual Build Our America event.
Build Our America is a celebration of the diverse coalition that so many have built to create a stronger and more inclusive America. I’m joining Pramila because she’s a fighter for working people, an advocate for serious action to address the climate crisis, and a leader for all of us in Congress.
We’ll discuss Pramila’s leadership in growing the progressive movement and her organizing work ahead of the midterm elections. The funds raised from this event will help Pramila travel to key districts across the country, host virtual phonebanks for other progressives, and donate to candidates who need additional funding. You won’t want to miss it, Peter.
The event is virtual and, for a limited time, we’re offering early bird tickets to all who can chip in $3 or anything at all to Pramila’s re-election campaign. [**Donate whatever you can NOW to join me + Pramila on Saturday, September 17th at 3:30pm PT/6:30pm ET. You won’t want to miss this!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16231?refcode=em20220901-1571&t=1&akid=1571%2E420207%2EbwjKii)
**[RSVP& Chip In →](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16231?refcode=em20220901-1571&t=2&akid=1571%2E420207%2EbwjKii)**
Even before she was elected to Congress in 2016, Pramila was an organizer in the fight for a $15 minimum wage. She knows what it means to fight for change inside and outside of Congress — it’s part of the reason she’s such an important progressive leader on Capitol Hill.
As Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, Pramila has elevated the power of progressives and grown the caucus to nearly 100 members. And she has been at the forefront of the work to invest in the clean energy we need to cut emissions and avert climate catastrophe, advocate for just and humane immigration policies, and protect our democracy and elections.
I know too many lawmakers in Congress listen to corporations more than they listen to the voice of the people. I’m with Pramila because she’s a leader who always puts the people first. And that’s why I’m joining her for Build Our America on September 17.
[**Peter, will you join us virtually on September 17 for Pramila’s annual Build Our America event? We have a lot to discuss about the midterms, the fight for transformative change in our country, and how Pramila is building our progressive movement for a better future.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16231?refcode=em20220901-1571&t=3&akid=1571%2E420207%2EbwjKii)
**[RSVP& Chip In →](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16231?refcode=em20220901-1571&t=4&akid=1571%2E420207%2EbwjKii)**
I hope to see you on the 17th, Peter.
Thank you,
Mark Ruffalo

I know too many lawmakers in Congress listen to corporations more than they listen to the voice of the people. I’m with Pramila because she’s a leader who always puts the people first. And that’s why I’m joining her for Build Our America on September 17. I hope to see you on the 17th, Peter. Thank you, Mark Ruffalo | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

Peter,

I want to thank everyone for all you've done to support this campaign.

Because of this people-powered team, we reached our crucial end-of-month fundraising goal yesterday! Now, we are starting September off strong, thanks to your support.

No matter what is thrown at us, this team never seems to slow down. **Thanks to your dedication, we are on track to bring this thing home come November 8th. And we can continue to help support my Democratic colleagues up and down the ballot.**

_Believe me_ when I say there's so much on the line in this election. Our fundamental rights and freedoms may come down to whether or not we can maintain our crucial (but narrow) Democratic majorities in the House and Senate, and that is something we can't take lightly.

I know we can keep the momentum going all the way through Election Day to keep Congress blue!

Thank you again, and as always, it's an honor to serve you,

Derek

Hi there, Peter, it's Trudy. I know you've heard from my team and me a lot in the past few days, but I need to personally thank you. You see, we've been up against a really critical end-of-month deadline – our first major fundraising deadline since we won our primary!
This was a make-or-break moment for our campaign. Our right-wing opponents and pundits are sure to look through these fundraising numbers to judge the strength of our movement.
**And, Peter, because people like you stepped up and believed in our campaign, I am thrilled to announce that we not only hit, but _exceeded _our end-of-month goal!**
Thank you so, so much for supporting and believing in this campaign.
Because of you, we are one step closer to winning this campaign and flipping Missouri blue.
Because of you, we are one step closer to bringing true compassion, integrity, and honesty to Washington;**we are one step closer to sending someone to****the Capitol who****will be no one's Senator but yours. **
Because of you, we are one step closer to ensuring that our children get the brighter, kinder future that they deserve.
**I'm so proud to be your Democratic nominee, and I'm incredibly grateful that you've chosen to believe in my campaign and in me. **I promise that I will work night and day to win this race and make you proud.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
– Trudy

**Unlike my opponent, Herschel Walker, I've made the decision to reject any and all corporate PAC money – which means our success depends on folks like you chipping in $5, even $****25****, at a time. So please, I need you with me to win:**
[**Will you give $5 or more now to help me defeat Walker, keep Georgia and the Senate blue, and continue making progress for folks across our state and country?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50083045/364567264/-1789705490?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3798-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MmJmNDc0NC0wMzJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uxU2tJxf0xXheXQd3Cf2S8cTQxvjxRHB-MM5dzv5Yuw=)

I support high-quality, accessible and affordable childcare because it supports us in Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula. It supports our families and helps us build a better future through the success of our children and their families. Inaccessible and unaffordable childcare has adverse economic impacts. It causes higher employee absences and turnover, postponement of education or training opportunities, reduced hours, and parents leaving the workforce. Reducing poverty, caring for our children, and providing relief to hard-working families is well-spent taxpayers' money. We will see significant economic benefits as it helps parents get back to work and pursue opportunities for their families. Reliable access to childcare can generate an additional $79,000 in lifetime earnings for parents. In addition, single parents who receive assistance for childcare payments are nearly 40% more likely to maintain employment over two years than those who do not. It's time our district has a leader in Congress working hard for hard-working families. We need quality childcare, health care, and education, which must be paid for and budgeted accordingly. I will work as your Representative in Washington with a vision for the future to improve the lives of Northern Michiganders and Yoopers. "Child care has been underfunded for decades, resulting in an inadequate supply of high-quality programs and too many families priced out of the system. Providers can only charge what families can afford, which often translates into near-poverty wages and limited benefits (if any) for early educators." - DEMANDING CHANGE, childcareaware.org We hear from many working families around the UP about how childcare is a significant issue for them. This needs legislative change to support working families, and it is the right thing to do. How can my opponent look parents in the eyes and tell them he opposes high-quality, accessible and affordable childcare?

clean_body: \- We were astonished to learn the average cost of childcare in Northern Michigan and the UP. This is unacceptable. How can my opponent look parents in the eyes and oppose making childcare accessible? | | | Our district’s average cost of childcare is over $10,000 per child yearly – sometimes costing parents half their salary to work and raise children. To reduce poverty, working families deserve relief. Childcare in Northern Michigan / U.P. exceeds $10K per child = Can you please make a contribution to help me get to Congress so I can fight for hardworking families of Michigan's First District. Time and again, Jack Bergman opposed making childcare affordable. We need to send someone to Congress with compassion. = | | = I support high-quality, accessible and affordable childcare because it supports us in Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula. It supports our families and helps us build a better future through the success of our children and their families. Inaccessible and unaffordable childcare has adverse economic impacts. It causes higher employee absences and turnover, postponement of education or training opportunities, reduced hours, and parents leaving the workforce. Reducing poverty, caring for our children, and providing relief to hard-working families is well-spent taxpayers' money. We will see significant economic benefits as it helps parents get back to work and pursue opportunities for their families. Reliable access to childcare can generate an additional $79,000 in lifetime earnings for parents. In addition, single parents who receive assistance for childcare payments are nearly 40% more likely to maintain employment over two years than those who do not. It's time our district has a leader in Congress working hard for hard-working families. We need quality childcare, health care, and education, which must be paid for and budgeted accordingly. I will work as your Representative in Washington with a vision for the future to improve the lives of Northern Michiganders and Yoopers. "Child care has been underfunded for decades, resulting in an inadequate supply of high-quality programs and too many families priced out of the system. Providers can only charge what families can afford, which often translates into near-poverty wages and limited benefits (if any) for early educators." - DEMANDING CHANGE, childcareaware.org We hear from many working families around the UP about how childcare is a significant issue for them. This needs legislative change to support working families, and it is the right thing to do. How can my opponent look parents in the eyes and tell them he opposes high-quality, accessible and affordable childcare? body:
|

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168376:6troXoVkN:m:1:3253819041:994F6AB486384A3DF82962C38ECE9425:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

body:
Peter,
As a nation, we are at a critical juncture. The rise of misinformation, the Big Lie, and far-right extremism has brought our country to the brink. The only thing that is going to protect and restore democracy in the United States is the American people. The people have to come together and unite across all sorts of political divides in the name of freedom and democracy.
As we get closer to the election, the stakes get higher and higher, and thanks to you, we have been able to stay on track to protect Colorado’s gold standard election system. In August, this grassroots team sent a resounding message that protecting the right to vote and expanding access to the polls is of the utmost importance.
I am eternally grateful to have the support of such fierce defenders of democracy. We have faced challenges, but we have shown where the people of Colorado stand.
I have no doubt that united, we will win this race and continue strengthening Colorado’s free and fair elections.
Gratefully,
Jena Griswold

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168404:6vZPXoVNe:m:1:3317145305:DC19995A0D2FF021720A5D5713438BD8:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

subject: Gryder: Sending Kids to School has Never Been Harder for Parents
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SCOTT GRYDER FOR CONGRESS**
body:
| | |
---
| | As summer comes to a close and Illinois students head back to the classroom, Scott Gryder released the statement below on the reckless Democrat agenda that is making this school year more costly and more difficult for families across the state. Scott Gryder is the Republican nominee challenging Democrat Rep. Lauren Underwood in the race for IL-14 this November. Lauren Underwood is a Democrat crony who puts the radical Biden agenda before Illinois families. [_Any donation you are able to give, $500, $250, $100, or even $50, will go a long way in helping Scott Gryder defeat Lauren Underwood and her liberal agenda._](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/ece42c7afc6d70999c32df07ccef91c9/41753/b6fc0561da8efd83/079a22247bbe1772c3d6b838967d376c/41753)

**Scott Gryder: Sending Kids to School Has Never Been Harder for Parents** Oswego, Ill. – Going back to school has never been more challenging. From inflation to shortages, nothing about getting kids ready and dropped off at the classroom is simple – and Joe Biden and Lauren Underwood are doing nothing to change that. Scott Gryder, Kendall County Board Chairman and Republican nominee for IL-14, knows that families deserve better. As your next U.S. Representative, Scott Gryder will deliver positive change for students and families: “Sending kids back to school this year brings new worries and anxieties – thanks to Lauren Underwood and Joe Biden. Democrats’ tax-and-spend agenda has caused the price of school supplies to skyrocket, costing families, on average, an additional $168. The increase in gas prices is forcing parents to pay $2,200 more at the pump, and with school bus driver shortages, driving to school is the only option for many families across our state. Instead of focusing on relief, the Underwood-Biden agenda is digging in on higher costs and higher taxes. Earlier this month, Lauren Underwood voted in support of the Inflation Reduction Act – a massive spending bill that will raise taxes on working families, hurt our already-weak economy, and do absolutely nothing to reduce inflation. Meanwhile, Joe Biden and his Education Department are on a mission to eliminate options for families and force every student to receive a government-issued education. Last month, Biden signed a final rule that makes it more challenging for new charter schools to form and existing ones to receive grant money – not surprisingly, it also gives the federal government greater authority over them. I believe that every family deserves their choice of an affordable, top-notch school that will provide students with a quality education and prepare them for whatever life path they aspire to – regardless of their zip code. That’s why as your representative, I will fight to end the reckless tax-and-spend agenda Lauren Underwood has spent her time in Congress championing. And when it comes to school choice, I will work to give power back to charter schools, and I will fight for increased tax credits for families wanting to send their children to private schools. Lauren Underwood has voted with Joe Biden 100% of the time. She’s not in Congress to work for you, she serves at Joe Biden’s beck and call. And while Underwood thinks she can dupe you with empty promises and take more of your tax dollars just to shove your kids into understaffed and failing public schools, I will always fight for you and your family. Enough is enough – it’s time to take our district back and restore the hope and promise that every first day should bring.” ### ________________________________________________________________________ More about Scott Gryder: Scott has a long history of leadership for the community he serves. Elected three times to the Kendall County Board, Scott currently serves as its Chairman. By being a common-sense, pragmatic conservative, Scott has worked to keep taxes low and supported responsible spending policies on the County Board. He will take the same approach to Congress. Scott grew up in Plano and has called Kendall County home for most of his life. A graduate of the University of Illinois with a degree in business administration, Scott successfully pursued his law degree at DePaul. He is an active member of the Federalist Society and is licensed to practice law in Illinois and the U.S. Northern District of Illinois. Scott and his wife live in Oswego with their daughter. Outside of politics, he is active with the Oswegoland Park Foundation Board, is a PrairieFest Sponsor, and serves on the Fox Valley Family YMCA Board. To learn more about Scott Gryder, please visit [www.scottgryder.com](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/ece42c7afc6d70999c32df07ccef91c9/41753/b6fc0561da8efd83/e49e6c35fc0e873bc3d6b838967d376c/41753) where you can sign up for news from the trail. Follow Scott on Facebook @GryderforCongress or on Twitter @Gryder4Congress. Illinois’ 14th Congressional District encompasses all or part of seven counties, including Bureau, DeKalb, Kane, Kendall, LaSalle, Will, and Putnam.

Scott Gryder is the Republican nominee challenging Democrat Rep. Lauren Underwood in the race for IL-14 this November. Lauren Underwood is a Democrat crony who puts the radical Biden agenda before Illinois families. Scott Gryder: Sending Kids to School Has Never Been Harder for Parents Oswego, Ill. – Going back to school has never been more challenging. From inflation to shortages, nothing about getting kids ready and dropped off at the classroom is simple – and Joe Biden and Lauren Underwood are doing nothing to change that. Scott Gryder, Kendall County Board Chairman and Republican nominee for IL-14, knows that families deserve better. As your next U.S. Representative, Scott Gryder will deliver positive change for students and families: “Sending kids back to school this year brings new worries and anxieties – thanks to Lauren Underwood and Joe Biden. Democrats’ tax-and-spend agenda has caused the price of school supplies to skyrocket, costing families, on average, an additional $168. The increase in gas prices is forcing parents to pay $2,200 more at the pump, and with school bus driver shortages, driving to school is the only option for many families across our state. Instead of focusing on relief, the Underwood-Biden agenda is digging in on higher costs and higher taxes. Earlier this month, Lauren Underwood voted in support of the Inflation Reduction Act – a massive spending bill that will raise taxes on working families, hurt our already-weak economy, and do absolutely nothing to reduce inflation. Meanwhile, Joe Biden and his Education Department are on a mission to eliminate options for families and force every student to receive a government-issued education. Last month, Biden signed a final rule that makes it more challenging for new charter schools to form and existing ones to receive grant money – not surprisingly, it also gives the federal government greater authority over them. I believe that every family deserves their choice of an affordable, top-notch school that will provide students with a quality education and prepare them for whatever life path they aspire to – regardless of their zip code. That’s why as your representative, I will fight to end the reckless tax-and-spend agenda Lauren Underwood has spent her time in Congress championing. And when it comes to school choice, I will work to give power back to charter schools, and I will fight for increased tax credits for families wanting to send their children to private schools. Lauren Underwood has voted with Joe Biden 100% of the time. She’s not in Congress to work for you, she serves at Joe Biden’s beck and call. And while Underwood thinks she can dupe you with empty promises and take more of your tax dollars just to shove your kids into understaffed and failing public schools, I will always fight for you and your family. Enough is enough – it’s time to take our district back and restore the hope and promise that every first day should bring.” ### ________________________________________________________________________ More about Scott Gryder: Scott has a long history of leadership for the community he serves. Elected three times to the Kendall County Board, Scott currently serves as its Chairman. By being a common-sense, pragmatic conservative, Scott has worked to keep taxes low and supported responsible spending policies on the County Board. He will take the same approach to Congress. Scott grew up in Plano and has called Kendall County home for most of his life. A graduate of the University of Illinois with a degree in business administration, Scott successfully pursued his law degree at DePaul. He is an active member of the Federalist Society and is licensed to practice law in Illinois and the U.S. Northern District of Illinois. Scott and his wife live in Oswego with their daughter. Outside of politics, he is active with the Oswegoland Park Foundation Board, is a PrairieFest Sponsor, and serves on the Fox Valley Family YMCA Board. To learn more about Scott Gryder, please visit where you can sign up for news from the trail. Follow Scott on Facebook @GryderforCongress or on Twitter @Gryder4Congress. | | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168390:JYzgXoVwN:m:1:3331421248:D6D3B033B297656D39AB81B4A9563656:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

I know we’ve asked a lot of you lately, but after last night’s fundraising deadline, we are starting September in a strong position. And the timing couldn’t be more important.
In campaigns, everything gets even busier after Labor Day. The challenges ahead are steep, but with hard work and faith, we can deliver real change for our families. We are going to fight tirelessly to fix the broken status quo that puts our democracy, our planet and our rights at risk.
The people of North Carolina deserve a voice in the U.S. Senate, not another insider who is beholden to giant corporations and the ultra-wealthy. I promise to be a champion for you and help level the playing field for everyone when we flip this seat.
Thank you again — from the bottom of my heart. I couldn’t be prouder of all that we have done. Just 68 days left to finish the job. Let’s get this done together.
Onward to victory,
Cheri Beasley

name: Brenda Siegel
subject: Won’t take this lying down
body:
| |
---
Friend, Yesterday, the administration announced atrocious changes to the Rental Assistance and Emergency Assistance programs. They knew this was coming for a long time and with not even 24 hours notice, they announced it to the public. **** The administration announced these changes without working with partners, without planning, and without regard for the impact on those they serve. Because of this announcement, many Vermonters will lose access to housing. **** 8,411 households will completely lose their assistance by December 1st. Let me say that again, 8,411 households. **** Here’s a brief summary of exactly what will happen: 1\. People making over 30% of the area median income will receive their last 100% need payment September 1. That amount will be reduced to 70% in October and 50% in November and NO ASSISTANCE by December 1st. 2\. People receiving other forms of assistance no longer qualify for the program on September 30th. That is 3015 families with not even a month's notice. 3\. People making under 30% of median income will receive a reduction to 70% of need by October 1. 4\. People receiving utility assistance will be reduced to 70% and it will be stripped entirely by year's end. 5\. There will be NO ERAP or VERAP applications accepted after September 30th. Ending access to the transitional housing program for those newly experiencing homelessness. **** To recap. Over twelve thousand households will be impacted by this decision. In a state where there is just over a 2% vacancy rate, people will have no where to go and no net to catch them. [Watch my full response to this outrageous decision here.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/A7GQnnr_XzUYyessq5BiRByHtfqivNyfjeMu4btusjzXQY4XpNoldE6G5fBpmcWnKo5w9CrJHAH161FG47cpwO_2eCEY1tgbnsEUSJ5G_SIyrA-GlC558syUzRenKWnMMwUaGYNwL-lvUENS3qQVykz6ggWGRcfjoglnjzHpVhU_ivpNs59Sk61t6MA-aS1DVkfhoCwax5_Qc8N2XFHncuCtDSWmJ4vX0N22rHVLBA4sCy4z7cJhaoWoGHmSW0D6pOgKKPtaqA0reS2r40x_zA/3p3/XxfDvtvaQWKL3cOpRSEtuw/h0/2Yrgy7BtO3R4BuX6_t8fb6CHHWNLQ6sujThw2-HCg0c)

This decision means that there will be more people without housing, and there will be immense harm to low- and moderate-income people across this entire state, to our neighbors and community members. With less than twenty-four hours before it would be implemented the administration announced this plan. **** I was asked what the solution should have been. The solution would have been proper planning and proper budgeting in this case, and working with the Legislature who was willing to work with the administration. Over and over again in between sessions, we have learned things that should have been known in advance. Now, there will be mass evictions in this state. **** I’ve been an advocate for better housing policy my entire life, and I am devastated by the administration’s announcement. Many Vermonters, including children, will be made homeless due to this abrupt decision. Vermont needs a governor who stands along side the most vulnerable instead of leaving them to risk freezing to death. We’re running because people deserve to be housed and callus decisions like these don't even come close to civility. We must stand up for everyone’s housing rights. clean_body: | | Friend, Yesterday, the administration announced atrocious changes to the Rental Assistance and Emergency Assistance programs. They knew this was coming for a long time and with not even 24 hours notice, they announced it to the public. ** The administration announced these changes without working with partners, without planning, and without regard for the impact on those they serve. Because of this announcement, many Vermonters will lose access to housing. 8,411 households will completely lose their assistance by December 1st. Let me say that again, 8,411 households. Here’s a brief summary of exactly what will happen: 1\. People making over 30% of the area median income will receive their last 100% need payment September 1. That amount will be reduced to 70% in October and 50% in November and NO ASSISTANCE by December 1st. 2\. People receiving other forms of assistance no longer qualify for the program on September 30th. That is 3015 families with not even a month's notice. 3\. People making under 30% of median income will receive a reduction to 70% of need by October 1. 4\. People receiving utility assistance will be reduced to 70% and it will be stripped entirely by year's end. 5\. There will be NO ERAP or VERAP applications accepted after September 30th. Ending access to the transitional housing program for those newly experiencing homelessness. To recap. Over twelve thousand households will be impacted by this decision. In a state where there is just over a 2% vacancy rate, people will have no where to go and no net to catch them. | This decision means that there will be more people without housing, and there will be immense harm to low- and moderate-income people across this entire state, to our neighbors and community members. With less than twenty-four hours before it would be implemented the administration announced this plan. I was asked what the solution should have been. The solution would have been proper planning and proper budgeting in this case, and working with the Legislature who was willing to work with the administration. Over and over again in between sessions, we have learned things that should have been known in advance. Now, there will be mass evictions in this state. ** I’ve been an advocate for better housing policy my entire life, and I am devastated by the administration’s announcement. Many Vermonters, including children, will be made homeless due to this abrupt decision. Vermont needs a governor who stands along side the most vulnerable instead of leaving them to risk freezing to death. We’re running because people deserve to be housed and callus decisions like these don't even come close to civility. We must stand up for everyone’s housing rights. # **Emilia Sykes Releases Opening Ad:
“My Community”**
_**Sykes Highlights Deep Ties to OH-13,
Bipartisan Record Of Helping Ohio Families**_
---
| AKRON, OH — Today, Democratic congressional nominee Emilia Sykes released her first television ad of the general election. Titled “My Community,” the ad highlights Sykes’ deep roots in her community and bipartisan, independent record of getting things done for her constituents as Minority Leader of the Ohio State Legislature. **“Homegrown candidate, homegrown values — it’s an honor to serve the community I’ve called home my entire life,” Sykes said. “When families are struggling, they need someone who will work with leaders from both sides of the aisle to cut taxes, lower costs and create good jobs. In Congress, I’ll continue to do the same, putting people over politics to serve the community that raised me.”**

**Click HERE to view “[My Community](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=580555ed52&e=7730fa895a).”

[](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=b5ab5742b7&e=7730fa895a)**
**Below is the transcript for “[My Community](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=bafe27e28d&e=7730fa895a).”**
This is the community that raised me.
Where people have trusted me to serve them.
The reason I put aside party politics.
To cut taxes.
And raise wages.
In congress, I’ll keep working with both parties
To lower costs.
Create good-paying jobs.
And put more money in your pockets.
Because when people are counting on you, you answer to them.
Not to any political party.
I’m Emilia Sykes, and I approve this message.

The OH-13 congressional race is a highly competitive matchup between Sykes and anti-choice extremist Madison Gesiotto Gilbert, who [district-shopped as she weighed in on where to run for office](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=6f2b13ce0e&e=7730fa895a). Recently, Inside Elections shifted their rating towards Sykes and [rated this race as “toss-up.”](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=fef096d68b&e=7730fa895a) ### **About Emilia Sykes**
Emilia Sykes is the State Representative for Ohio’s 34th legislative district. Born in Akron and raised on the city’s west side, Emilia has worked tirelessly to keep jobs in our state and expand opportunity for working families in Northeast Ohio. As House Minority Leader she worked with Republicans and Democrats to deliver real results for Ohio’s families, businesses, and seniors.

Emilia will bring a fresh perspective to Washington, and fight for opportunity for every child, senior, and family in Northeast Ohio, regardless of their politics or beliefs.

Learn more about Emilia Sykes at [www.EmiliaSykesforCongress.com](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=3ab1f28047&e=7730fa895a). name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Colleges are teaching Black people to hate America
body:
Radical professors and the media want us divided. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6916%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=PArQZSnEOxI7c%2bKoHPnCbw&sysid=1)
[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74165%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6ETIZxzvAtw9QYeCMdShXQ&sysid=1)

Friend,

Radical professors and the media want us divided.

Hatred is something taught to people. And it’s a sad reality that Black people are taught to hate America and see themselves as victims.

* The media spreads lies about criminals like George Floyd to inflame racial tensions.

* CRT teaches us to divide the world by skin color.

* Worst of them all, colleges teach Black students to see themselves as oppressed.

But in this country, _we are not divided_. It’s all a myth -- just a figment of someone’s sick imagination.

You can be whatever you want to pursue. You can accomplish anything with enough passion, honor, and integrity. **There is no other country in the whole world where Black people prosper as much as they do here. **

But young people are confused and convinced that they have barriers in place that do not exist.

We have to change the way we perceive ourselves.

**That’s why I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens**. We are changing the narrative as we seek to abolish the victim mentality.

And I have great news to share with you...

**This fall, the BLEXIT Student Movement is launching its first official club at the University of Maryland Eastern Shore, a historically Black college.**

[_**Friend, can you help me create more BLEXIT student clubs in historically Black colleges? Click here to donate $10, $35, $50, or any amount >>>**_](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74166%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lEDRcggVWyEeR75yDEk3Yw&sysid=1)

We’re starting a new initiative to reach college students, the BLEXIT Student Movement clubs.

These clubs bring BLEXIT’s five pillars to life through events and outreach efforts on their campus, especially in historically Black colleges.

1. **Advocating** for School Choice.

2. **Promoting** criminal justice reform by developing positive relationships between police and minority communities.

3. **Championing** entrepreneurship and free enterprise.

4. **Developing** history programs that will inspire minority children.

5. **Presenting** the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

These clubs also go to places where no other organizations can effectively reach to combat the victimhood mentality.

BLEXIT is helping Black and minority communities exit the victimhood mentality by changing the way we see ourselves. Will you support BLEXIT’s mission by donating today?

[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74165%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6ETIZxzvAtw9QYeCMdShXQ&sysid=1)

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**WHAT IS BLEXIT?**

People ask me all the time - what does BLEXIT mean?

It’s an exit from the vicious cycle of victimhood mentality promoted by the media and colleges.

They teach us to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, that the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

**Victimhood is a mental virus that infects our Black and minority communities. We need to eradicate it. **

BLEXIT is getting Black and urban communities to EXIT the victimhood and become victors. What are victors? Individuals who can think for themselves and promote a healthy community of Faith, Freedom, and Family.

We are looking to open another club in a historically Black college this semester. But it can be difficult...

**Candace and I have a goal of raising $5,000 (that’s $2,500 per Student Movement club) to get our start this upcoming semester. **

But for every additional $2,500 raised, you make it possible for us to open a new Student Movement club during the school year.

| If you are a parent, then knowledge of your children’s healthcare provision is your basic right.

Sadly, AB-1940 just passed the Senate, likely stripping away even more of your rights when your children are at public schools.

That’s right - now schools can provide harmful medical services while keeping you in the dark.

Lets cut straight to the chase - this is an attack on your rights as a parent and what’s best for your children.

This is why thousands of parents are taking their children out of public school.

Because Gavin’s legislature is prioritizing cultural revolution ahead of your knowledge or consent for your child.

But as a parent - I believe it is your basic right to be educated, informed, and asked permission before your child can receive healthcare services at school.

I believe your children are your children. Not the State’s children.

But it seems as if Gavin Newsom is doing everything he can to continue to strip away parents’ rights.

This is why this election in November is so crucial.

We must protect our children!

\- Senator Brian Dahle

name: Pro Life Update
subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?"
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3hmhu3oojcocg8940g267e4hpb6rjj9osp15tng_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ugpb5dr56gqn4t74s4om1d5nmlj78pr4mjgm1c3l6uq36c5nc5rr1clgmmq38o37q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphh62pm0ptie9j3ao5jcgrr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or3c9g66oj1c9im49fg)
| | | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdami3rmv94v6ft5flo5pj7238cqobv2q2nph750_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1hm4ob2clh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zuv2j68budcvulg7ans481et6lduggfgg0j21jg8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1hm4ob2clh2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zruc9qnqeaihli68f7fsi16d3ce3e1jgo47r407g_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1hm4ob2clh2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Peter-
America is at war with the Mexican drug cartels. Even if we aren't on a war footing, the cartels are. Recent drone footage showed Mexican cartels camping out just a few hundred yards from our border, in what is essentially a forward operating base. These bases are filled with cartel soldiers armed to the teeth with long guns and body armor.
And one of their main sources of revenue - fentanyl - is flooding across our borders and killing Americans. In July, Border Patrol agents saw a nearly 200% jump in seizures of fentanyl at the U.S.-Mexico border. Of the more than 108,000 overdose deaths last year, more than 80,000 were linked with fentanyl. Now the cartels are improvising with "rainbow fentanyl," colored fentanyl pills disguised as candy.
This is our biggest national security threat and it's right on our doorstep, being fueled by Biden's open border policies. Since President Biden has taken office, the U.S. has had almost 4 million [3,926,529] migrant encounters. CBP had 199,976 migrant encounters along the Southwest border in July 2022, including 134,362 single adults, 52,040 family units, and 13,299 unaccompanied minors.
And as of July 30, 60 people whose names appear on the terror watch list were stopped trying to cross into the U.S. - Mexico border between ports of entry in this fiscal year.
We need to get on a war footing now, and the first step to taking back control of our border is taking back control of Congress. Peter, Senate Democrats, along with Former President Barack Obama, are gathering in New York City next week for a fundraiser benefiting the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee (DSCC). Much like the cost of the legislation they've rammed through the Senate over the past year, the cost of entry to the fundraising event is enough to bankrupt most middle-income Americans. According to the invitation, general admission tickets can be had for the low price of $25,000, with VIP tickets available for $50,000. Where will the money go? Raphael Warnock and other key Democrat senators around the country will benefit from these far-Left donations. I need your help to offset the money that this event is going to raise on behalf of my opponent.
