subject: Demand an end to online child abuse!
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-CMspg)
---
Dear Friend, The online sexual exploitation of children has risen at an alarming rate in recent years. Internet predators and traffickers have easy and anonymous access to vulnerable and unsuspecting children, who often fall into the predator's grooming trap and are seduced into sending sexual images of themselves. Online grooming is one of the many tactics used by predators to create child sex abuse material (CSAM), previously referred to as child pornography. Their suffering is not a one-time crime. Instead, any time the depiction of their abuse is sold, shared, posted online, bartered or used privately for a consumer's sexual gratification, the crime against the victim is repeated. In 2021, more than 29.3 million CyberTipline reports were made containing over 84.9 million images, videos and other content related to suspected child sexual exploitation, an increase of 35% from 2020. Sadly, millions of children and families have suffered while multi-billion-dollar electronic service providers refuse to do their part to keep kids safe on their platforms. Big Tech continues to avoid accountability and legal recourse by claiming "blanket immunity" from any responsibility. _Instead of protecting children, greedy internet platforms knowingly allow minors to be abused and exploited - That_ '_s why Enough Is Enough (EIE) strongly advocates for the passage of the bipartisan bill, Earn It Act (S. 3538) which is being cosponsored by 22 Senators and is pending in both the Senate and the House of Representatives.__ _ If enacted, this critical piece of bi-partisan legislation will remove blanket immunity for social media and technology companies that knowingly facilitate the distribution of CSAM on its platforms. This priority bill gives victims of CSAM the chance to restore their privacy and get justice from those who facilitated the crimes committed against them. **Together, we must urge Congress to act immediately to protect our kids from devastating online risks that can ruin their lives.** [**Let Congress know that immediate action must be taken to end Big Tech** '**s** "**blanket immunity," and stop these abusive crimes against children by signing our petition today.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)
---
[**Sign Today: End Online Child Exploitation**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)
---
Due to record number of child sex abuse material distributed on the internet, legislative initiatives are needed now more than ever to hold Big Tech accountable for knowingly allowing the facilitation of this content on its platforms. Millions of these cases of abuse go unidentified and unreported by the Big Tech platforms that host them because there are so few consequences when these companies look the other way, thanks to "blanket immunity" from criminal prosecution. This crime flourishes as profit-hungry Big Tech companies capitalize on the multi-billion-dollar supply-and-demand chain for images and videos of innocent children, many as young as infants and toddlers, being sexually abused and often violently raped. Along with your support, EIE stands ready to end the epidemic of online sexual exploitation of minors, and to make the internet safer for children and families. _But our legislators need to hear YOUR voice. _ [**Sign this petition urging Congress to end Big Tech** '**s** "**blanket immunity," and hold Internet Service Providers legally liable if they continue allowing predatory exploitation and abuse of children online.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace._taPR35Q)
---
[**Sign Today: End Online Child Exploitation**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace._ul7jLhrA)
---
We urge all caring Americans to take action by signing this petition to defend child dignity and protect children who are sexually exploited on the internet, and please consider making a generous donation to support our critical cause, because we can't continue without your support. Big Tech is finally going to be held responsible if they continue doing nothing to keep our kids safe. It's time we collectively say - "_Enough Is Enough!"_ [**Stand up for vulnerable children now by signing our petition.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-6hlYfbsytlyVGh-ryOQ) Our future generations will thank you later,
---
Donna Rice HughesPresident / CEOEnough Is Enough

Peter Welch

body:
Our country is plagued by phony career politicians who don’t have our best interests in mind.

Friend – I'm Retired Navy SEAL Derrick Van Orden and the Trump Conservative Candidate running in Wisconsin’s Third Congressional District. You may not know much about me, but my story isn’t anything like the bigwig Washington politicians. I joined the Navy when I was 18 years old and defended our great nation, serving two combat deployments in Iraq and Afghanistan. I did it for one purpose: to protect the freedoms that we are so privileged to experience. I love my country and I’m not done fighting for it just yet. **So many people today are afraid of being silenced or canceled, but not me. I am proud of who I am and I won’t change for anyone. I am:
**********
* **TRUMP-ENDORSED
**
* **100% MAGA**
* **PROUD CHRISTIAN GRANDFATHER, FATHER, AND HUSBAND**
* **PRO-MILITARY, PRO-CAPITALISM, AND PRO-AMERICA FIRST**
* **AND A PROUD PATRIOT**

As a retired Navy SEAL, I’ve never backed down from a fight – and I’m not about to start either. The dishonest, clown-show, liberal media can call me whatever name they want. Whether it’d be “deplorable” or “moron,” I’m still standing. **I’ve had enough of their antics and I know you have too. name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Colleges are teaching Black people to hate America
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168548:6UfuFoVNQ:m:1:3317145305:4CEE9A591922760F0C88A75D1CAFBFE3:r)

Peter,

Radical professors and the media want us divided.

Hatred is something taught to people. And it's a sad reality that Black people are taught to hate America and see themselves as victims.
* The media spreads lies about criminals like George Floyd to inflame racial tensions.
* CRT teaches us to divide the world by skin color.
* Worst of them all, colleges teach Black students to see themselves as oppressed.

But in this country, _we are not divided_. It's all a myth -- just a figment of someone's sick imagination.

You can be whatever you want to pursue. You can accomplish anything with enough passion, honor, and integrity. **There is no other country in the whole world where Black people prosper as much as they do here. **

But young people are confused and convinced that they have barriers in place that do not exist.

We have to change the way we perceive ourselves.

**That 's why I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens**. We are changing the narrative as we seek to abolish the victim mentality.

And I have great news to share with you...

**This fall, the BLEXIT Student Movement is launching its first official club at the University of Maryland Eastern Shore, a historically Black college.**

[_**Peter, can you help me create more BLEXIT student clubs in historically Black colleges? Click here to donate $25, $35, $50, or any amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168548:6UfuFoVNQ:m:1:3317145305:4CEE9A591922760F0C88A75D1CAFBFE3:r)

We're starting a new initiative to reach college students, the BLEXIT Student Movement clubs.

These clubs bring BLEXIT's five pillars to life through events and outreach efforts on their campus, especially in historically Black colleges.
1. **Advocating** for School Choice.
2. **Promoting** criminal justice reform by developing positive relationships between police and minority communities.
3. **Championing** entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
4. **Developing** history programs that will inspire minority children.
5. **Presenting** the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

These clubs also go to places where no other organizations can effectively reach to combat the victimhood mentality.

BLEXIT is helping Black and minority communities exit the victimhood mentality by changing the way we see ourselves. Will you support BLEXIT's mission by donating today?

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168548:6UfuFoVNQ:m:1:3317145305:4CEE9A591922760F0C88A75D1CAFBFE3:r)

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**WHAT IS BLEXIT?**

People ask me all the time - what does BLEXIT mean?

It's an exit from the vicious cycle of victimhood mentality promoted by the media and colleges.

They teach us to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

**Victimhood is a mental virus that infects our Black and minority communities. We need to eradicate it. **

BLEXIT is getting Black and urban communities to EXIT the victimhood and become victors. What are victors? Individuals who can think for themselves and promote a healthy community of Faith, Freedom, and Family.

We are looking to open another club in a historically Black college this semester. But it can be difficult...

**Candace and I have a goal of raising $5,000 (that 's $2,500 per Student Movement club) to get our start this upcoming semester. **

But for every additional $2,500 raised, you make it possible for us to open a new Student Movement club during the school year.

subject: From the bottom of my heart

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

From the bottom of my heart, thank you. Thank you for supporting our
campaign and for believing in our movement’s ability to bring
transformative change to our Commonwealth.

I’m happy to report that we were able to reach our August fundraising goal
by midnight. Every dollar that supporters chipped in gives our campaign
the funds we need to build our grassroots organizing strategy, to reach
out to voters across Kentucky, and get Rand Paul out of office.

As we get closer and closer to Election Day, keeping up this powerful
momentum will be more important than ever. Our movement is strong, our
campaign is growing, and people across the Commonwealth are fired up.
Let’s win this race, make some history, and give this Senate seat back to
the people of Kentucky.

Our plans for digital organizing, recruitment, and voter outreach are
underway. We’ve been recruiting volunteers all year for this moment. And
we’re continuing to spread our message all across the Commonwealth.

Peter, your
support energizes me. Together, we can work towards a future for our
Commonwealth that we can all be proud of — and to bring in a new era of
leadership, from the hood to the holler.

I love you Kentucky,

Charles

name: Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: “Ranked Choice Voting” coming to your state? Important news…
body:
| | | |
---
---
There are events, requests for help, and other important information that I wanted to share with you. One item is for everyone across the country. Two other items are state-specific, and one item is about America First Policy Institute’s tour that is coming to multiple states.
---
| | |
---
**NATIONWIDE** Have you heard of **Ranked Choice Voting (RCV)?** It destroyed Alaska’s elections, and may be coming to your state next. Some of our election integrity coalition allies have warned that the forces behind RCV have a lot of money and their goal is to sneak this into every state. There are even some Republicans (‘Republicans’) supporting this, which the RCV advocates use to make it seem like it’s a policy everyone can get behind. Make no mistake, Ranked Choice Voting is AWFUL. The Foundation for Government Accountability has put together some great resources to explain what RCV is and why it is truly terrible. Read through the resources below, and then be on the lookout for it in your state, especially if you live in a blue state – though they will try to implement it in red states too! In fact, note the next item below – Nevada residents will be voting on RCV in November!
* [Ranked Choice Voting is a Disaster](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
* [Ranked Choice Voting: A Disaster in Disguise](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._3Q)
* [The Truth About Ranked Choice Voting](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)

Public Interest Legal Foundation also has a couple of resources on this subject that you should read as well.
* [Ranked-choice voting is a scheme to keep politicians in power](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
* [Down the hatch: How left-wing election reforms can be](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NzM3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/WEWZ_wxCLORweHnb6D4VTQ) [forced on unsuspecting communities](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NzM3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/AxcTssuXIvw1D2FjYbInVg) _(This report explains how RCV benefits establishment candidates)_

---
| | |
---
**NEVADA** Speaking of Ranked Choice Voting –**it’s on the ballot in November in Nevada!!** **If you live in Nevada, you must vote NO on Question 3 on your ballot (also called ‘**[**Top 5 Ranked Choice Voting Initiative**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)**’).** **If you know someone who lives in Nevada, please reach out and tell them to vote NO!** Read through the resources in the section about Ranked Choice Voting above, email them out to everyone you know, and post on social media about it. This cannot be allowed to pass in Nevada!
---
| | |
---
**FLORIDA** The Florida Fair Elections Coalition is asking for your help. Please let them know about election integrity efforts in your county.

“To help us understand the inner workings of each county, please give us a summary of what you saw in your county, at your precincts, and at your SOE office by [**answering a few questions in this survey**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._ke1AuOQcrwG6grpOu_aWg).”
---
| | |
---
**OTHER STATES** America First Policy Institute and their C4, America First Works, has launched a town hall tour to combat the lies Biden is telling about the deceitfully-named “Inflation Reduction Act” on his own nationwide tour. He is trying to sway votes by lying They have already been to Iowa, New Mexico, and Pennsylvania, and will have 15 other key stops in the next 30-60-90 days and beyond. They have visits planned for Ohio, Wisconsin, Arizona, North Carolina, Virginia, Georgia, and Tennessee, among others. When the full tour schedule comes out, we will send more details!
---
|
---
**If you would like to support the work Tea Party Patriots Action is doing to secure our elections,[please consider a generous donation](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to help us as we head into the midterm elections.** We have helped to build statewide election integrity coalitions and local election integrity citizen task forces in key states; training patriots, providing resources, and supporting them as they work for honest and transparent elections. But there is more work to be done in those states and every other state!
---
[CONTRIBUTE](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
| | |
---

name: Tom Fitton
subject: We will not let up!
body:
You are one of our loyal supporters, so you know how Judicial Watch is working hard every day to fight for the rule of law and against public corruption and unlawful government secrecy

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

We urgently need you to give your support to Judicial Watch now!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60074&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

Because with a national election taking place in just two months, and a new Congress taking office in January, Judicial Watch is...

* **Achieving important progress fighting for honest elections.****We are now pursuing lawsuits in _four more states_ for their failure to clean their voter rolls; **_and our lawyers are now reviewing federal data to help determine if more lawsuits are needed_ ; and...

* Filing record numbers of Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests and lawsuits **to find out what our government is up to...especially our groundbreaking legal efforts to compel the FBI to release all of the facts behind the politicized and unprecedented FBI raid on former President Trump 's Florida home; and...**

* Intensifying our investigation and adding to our number of lawsuits against federal and state government agencies seeking more key information and secret documents pertaining to **_Biden family corruption_ ; and...**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60074&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

* Uncovering important information through litigation**to expose and challenge the use of taxpayer dollars to indoctrinate our military academies and our entire military... plus school children...with hateful, racist, Marxist "Critical Race Theory" propaganda; and...**

* Investigating and filing more successful lawsuits against more state and local governments that are enacting "woke" statutes or programs that violate state and federal civil rights laws **by unlawfully discriminating against individuals based on race, gender, or sexual preference; and...**

* **Exposing Big Tech and Big Government** efforts to unlawfully suppress and even silence conservatives...**and we continue to expose the unprecedented attack on the rule of law by the Biden administration 's REFUSAL to enforce immigration laws.**

You can see why the timing of your donation matters so much to us now!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60074&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

**_With your help now you can be assured that Judicial Watch _****_will not let up on any single one of our lawsuits or investigations_!**

If you have recently made a contribution to help us - thank you very much!

But if you have not, _[then I urge you to please do so now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60074&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)_...

...because we are fighting so hard, _and with so much_ _impact_ , on an unprecedented number of fronts today!

I believe you share our commitment to holding government bureaucrats and corrupt politicians in both parties accountable under the law.

And I wouldn’t ask for your special help today if we didn’t require sustained support for the full range of our investigations, litigation and public education programs.

You see, our ability to persist in all of our work depends in large measure on the loyalty and commitment of patriotic Americans like you!

**_We can only continue to be effective if we have the resources_** to counter the delaying tactics of government lawyers in court (_we are being aggressively stonewalled_ by the Biden administration over our lawful requests for a broad range of public documents), meet court-imposed deadlines for filings and appeals, and press ahead with all of our investigations into cases of public corruption and law-breaking - whether committed by Republicans _or_ Democrats.

**The essential work of Judicial Watch has never been more important ...or effective...in fighting against unlawful government secrecy and corruption.**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60074&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

_Clearly, our country is in a rule of law of crisis_. And I cannot imagine where this nation would be if not for Judicial Watch.

But I'm confident that _[with your special help today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60074&L=27940&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xNjQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Qk1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)_ we will continue to meet our nation's urgent need for a strong, independent and effective government watchdog.

Thank you in advance for your giving us your support!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also the GOP Nominee in the MUST WIN race in NC-14, a brand-new district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.

[**That 's why I'm humbly asking if you'll chip in just a few bucks today.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zidtgp8dbnaov60ka1ku6rn02hv1amgngfpo2cuo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c1hm6p72clh2bs)

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can't win this race. But I bet you've heard that one before...

body:
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5fc735b0ff384ce6adade7e10e46e534&_e=6qK8grSgd_3WNIrZl-XjVktpVkR6FQwGuqOHF3U8XisMkautnPUvTrvuhb5NeKHDEKySZLp5WATIJyIwecYQ4B0SRCjlIVla5bnMF-R55_yACfcNTmZ2GyyqGXozc2xfqPxLQXtas1vK5aYq25t2LWXB6sPi7mFj-0wg1BDqgQQ4Rw_5rTL7LQTEBBvo-uJP7T3hAvxy1JpKVittKoajPW--uxdrHXDsXbadrbO4yLffOsZ8ZhROts12ov1PsZNxCLxBerrqRJUoLxwaGDuza1TzjyBI06QOAxB1nNCz9O4%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5fc735b0ff384ce6adade7e10e46e534&_e=6qK8grSgd_3WNIrZl-XjVktpVkR6FQwGuqOHF3U8XisMkautnPUvTrvuhb5NeKHDEKySZLp5WATIJyIwecYQ4B0SRCjlIVla5bnMF-R55_yACfcNTmZ2GyyqGXozc2xfqPxLQXtas1vK5aYq25t2LWhxtLATtfhtMvemgMij00nzM28UJbP0rXobs3ZEw1v-bTEtQaSi4EdmBUHEE-9whQp1LUJ--VFHPeL5-V2erHkwsRIx_XB2pPayoK67Pa5d1Ff8KphfTeP6c59gipdT3ICzj-ctk-xp5vn62PbC6pc%3D)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

| It’s hard to believe it’s been a full year since I launched my campaign. And what a year it’s been!

I am willing to wager that I have met more people, listened to more stories, and shaken more hands in the past year than my opponent has in her entire 14 years in Washington.

Where’s Chellie? Pingree votes by proxy nearly 50% of the time, one of the top 20 in Congress! She’s not only absent in her own district – she’s absent from her job, too!

Mainers need and deserve courageous leadership, and a Representative that shows up for work!

With only 67 days left until Election Day, it's more important than ever that we raise enough money to finish strong and retire progressive Chellie Pingree.

Can you chip in with a donation now?

Thank you!
-Ed

body:

---
| | Peter, What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? Joe Biden's been in the basement for months. He pops out - delivers a massively unpopular plan for student loan forgiveness - and goes back to avoiding the public. That peek-a-boo act must be written into the official Democrat playbook because my opponent, Katie Hobbs, is doing the exact same thing! She refuses to debate. She refuses to show her face to the people of Arizona. If she's not making a plea to the radical left for more Soros money to fund her campaign, no one hears from her at all. This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That's because**I 'M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... The failing establishment elites are closed doors.
It's time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I'm the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)
---
Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that's what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Peter, let's not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country.** ** It's our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It's our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay.** ** And it's our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track.** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona!** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It's game time.** ** And I need you on my side.** ****_[Will you support our momentum?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)___**
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)_** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168471:JXyqeoVlN:m:1:3331421248:81FECFBA7F6C631F8700595F37E1E66A:r)

About 30 years ago, I was a little younger, a little less gray, and was a young lieutenant.

_**My tank was Bravo 21.**_ My gunner was a young man named Sayed - the best gunner in our platoon.

We were preparing to fight the Soviets during the Cold War and had just finished a training run.

**Remarkably, we had just hit two consecutive moving targets at a distance of little more than a mile. **

After accomplishing this remarkable feat, Sayed turned to me and said "Lieutenant, America is awesome".

**That 's why I'm upset. I'm upset that the Democrats don't accept this basic truth. **

Instead, they broadcast the lie that America is inherently evil and suggest our founding values must be cast aside.

Hatred is something taught to people. And it's a sad reality that Black people are taught to hate America and see themselves as victims.
* The media spreads lies about criminals like George Floyd to inflame racial tensions.
* CRT teaches us to divide the world by skin color.
* Worst of them all, colleges teach Black students to see themselves as oppressed.

But in this country, _we are not divided_. It's all a myth -- just a figment of someone's sick imagination.

You can be whatever you want to pursue. You can accomplish anything with enough passion, honor, and integrity. **There is no other country in the whole world where Black people prosper as much as they do here. **

But young people are confused and convinced that they have barriers in place that do not exist.

We have to change the way we perceive ourselves.

**That 's why I co-founded the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens**. We are changing the narrative as we seek to abolish the victim mentality.

And I have great news to share with you...

**This fall, the BLEXIT Student Movement is launching its first official club at the University of Maryland Eastern Shore, a historically Black college.**

[_**Peter, can you help me create more BLEXIT student clubs in historically Black colleges? Click here to donate $25, $35, $50, or any amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168533:6vh_SoVNF:m:1:3331421248:E7D5434CE65CAE696CA324407083D244:r)

We're starting a new initiative to reach college students, the BLEXIT Student Movement clubs.

These clubs bring BLEXIT's five pillars to life through events and outreach efforts on their campus, especially in historically Black colleges.
1. **Advocating** for School Choice.
2. **Promoting** criminal justice reform by developing positive relationships between police and minority communities.
3. **Championing** entrepreneurship and free enterprise.
4. **Developing** history programs that will inspire minority children.
5. **Presenting** the message of BLEXIT through art and live experiences.

These clubs also go to places where no other organizations can effectively reach to combat the victimhood mentality.

BLEXIT is helping Black and minority communities exit the victimhood mentality by changing the way we see ourselves. Will you support BLEXIT's mission by donating today?

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61168533:6vh_SoVNF:m:1:3331421248:E7D5434CE65CAE696CA324407083D244:r)

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**WHAT IS BLEXIT?**

People ask me all the time - what does BLEXIT mean?

It's an exit from the vicious cycle of victimhood mentality promoted by the media and colleges.

They teach us to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, that the police are our enemies, and that racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

**Victimhood is a mental virus that infects our Black and minority communities. We need to eradicate it. **

BLEXIT is getting Black and urban communities to EXIT the victimhood and become victors. What are victors? Individuals who can think for themselves and promote a healthy community of Faith, Freedom, and Family.

We are looking to open another club in a historically Black college this semester. But it can be difficult...

**Candace and I have a goal of raising $5,000 (that 's $2,500 per Student Movement club) to get our start this upcoming semester. **

But for every additional $2,500 raised, you make it possible for us to open a new Student Movement club during the school year.

Peter, can you donate to BLEXIT today? Your gift will help us empower Black communities and abolish the narrative of the victimhood mentality.

name: Rebecca Rodriguez
subject: We’re grateful for you!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
You helped us end the summer strong.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220901-3348-header&t=1&akid=3348%2E2526796%2E_8cx2T)
With summer coming to a close, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you. August was a fantastic month for NY-14 and our movement across the country, and that’s in no small part thanks to dedicated volunteers and supporters like you.
🎒 We distributed 500+ backpacks to kids across The Bronx and Queens alongside our community partners to help families get ready for back-to-school.
✉️ Alexandria **[rallied](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14861?t=2&akid=3348%2E2526796%2E_8cx2T)** at the American Postal Workers National Convention, celebrating all the successes we’ve had in Congress this year to make the USPS stronger and better funded — including a pilot program for postal banking!
👨👩👦 As Alexandria continues to fight in Congress for paid federal leave and better support for childcare, our team hosted a **[virtual workshop](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14862?t=3&akid=3348%2E2526796%2E_8cx2T)** on organizing childcare collectives to help give parents solutions now.
💰 We finally saw progress with student loan debt relief, and **[continued to push for cancellations of higher debt amounts](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14863?t=4&akid=3348%2E2526796%2E_8cx2T)**.
💸 **[Alexandria voted for the Inflation Reduction Act](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14864?t=5&akid=3348%2E2526796%2E_8cx2T)** , which will reduce carbon emissions by 40 percent, allow Medicare to negotiate for lower drug prices, increase taxes on the wealthiest, and much more!
📓 Our team concluded our **[Homework Helpers summer program with Start Lighthouse](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14865?t=6&akid=3348%2E2526796%2E_8cx2T)** , in which third graders completed a curriculum to build skills in reading and empathy.
🗳️ Kristen Gonzalez won her primary for the New York State Senate, despite being outraised hundreds of thousands of dollars!
🎉 The Squad all won their primaries, despite facing millions of spending from special interest groups.
🍎 Our allies on the local and federal level in New York — Senator Jabari Brisport, Senator Gustavo Rivera, Rep. Jamaal Bowman, and Rep. Nydia Velazquez — all won their primary elections.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=ocasio-campaign.krJqR8&refcode=em20220901-3348-P_OTH_TYE_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=3348%2E2526796%2E_8cx2T)
_Our team distributing food and backpacks at one of several community events in NY-14 this month._
With continued support like this, I’m sure it’s going to be a fantastic fall!
Solidarity,
Rebecca Rodriguez
Campaign Manager
Team AOC

Friend: Each and every day it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.
But I know a thing or two about persevering, and _winning_ , even when the odds are stacked against me.
I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. **There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South.** But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today.
I carry the spirit of her words with me even still – as I reflect on my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50098980/364625406/-1315874399?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4207-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODZmYTY0Ny0yODJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y-TAdlszDAl1UbJW3LWoU9ptTSrqqzPUZNRe_Zwg0-A=)
**There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate** – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
And friend, I know firsthand there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate, because no one should be above the law.
My road to this moment was not easy. But I'm not sure that there’s anywhere except America where a little Black girl – the daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the '60s South – could have a story so filled with opportunities like these. And I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good, so that anyone can have a story of opportunity.
This may be my toughest challenge yet, which is why I'm urging you – every last person reading this email – to chip in whatever you can to ensure I have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and win in Florida: [**Please, will you give $5 or more to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? Val Demings

Hi, folks. Just wanted to check in to make sure you saw my email
from earlier.

But now? I’m feeling pretty damn good.

September. But I took a quick look at today’s donor list and didn’t see

Tim

update.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20709?t=1013&amount=25&akid=5329%2E3611125%2EEnNHG0 ]Tim hand

I freakin’ hate sending these emails, so I’m just gonna cut straight to
the chase, Folks:

We fell short of our $500,000 End-of-Month fundraising goal for August.

I know, it stinks. But with your continued support, I truly believe we can
get back on track and win the race that will decide Senate control in
November.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20709?t=1014&amount=25&akid=5329%2E3611125%2EEnNHG0 ]If you believe, will you pitch in $5, $10, or whatever makes sense for
your budget right now to make up for this missed fundraising goal so we
can flip Ohio blue?

going to be smooth sailing once JD Vance stumbled his way to the GOP
nomination.

Not only did that mean an anti-abortion, anti-democracy extremist was one
step closer to Washington, but it also meant our grassroots campaign was
up against the Silicon Valley billionaires and GOP megadonors who will
stop at NOTHING to take back Senate control.

So while JD kicks his feet up and watches national Republicans pour
millions of dollars into Ohio on his behalf, our grassroots campaign is
fighting back $10 and $20 at a time.

So far, that grassroots energy has put us in a dead heat with JD in the
polls. But we can’t afford to miss a single fundraising goal if we want to
keep pace and finally pull ahead.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/20709?t=1016&amount=25&akid=5329%2E3611125%2EEnNHG0 ]August was tough, so we need a strong September. Will you chip in to

supporters like you are willing to take us.

name: Will Bertellotti
subject: FWD: Share your Sustainability Stories with OLCV!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters and authorized by Andrea Salinas for Congress
body:
| | | Hi there, There’s a chance you missed my email last week, so I’m following up to remind you that OLCV is collecting Sustainability Stories! We’re looking to hear stories from our supporters about a conscious choice or change you have made recently to use clean energy, diminish your contributions to climate change, or live in a more eco-friendly manner, and the positive impact this shift in your consumption, lifestyle, or energy usage has had on your life. _We’ve already received over a dozen amazing stories, and we’re so excited to read more!_ _**To submit yours, email anywhere from 1-5 paragraphs telling your story to[ olcv@olcv.org ](mailto:olcv@olcv.org?subject=Sustainability%20Stories)using the subject line “Sustainability Stories.”**_ The options for what you could write about are very broad, so I thought I’d share an example from my life to help spark your ideas for your own story. _Growing up in Los Angeles, I wasted so much of my life in traffic, waiting in an idle gas-powered car for hours on my way from point A to point B, and generating tons of pollution in the process. Upon moving to Oregon, I vowed to live a different, car-free life, and bought an old, purple Motobecane bicycle from the 80s after my first Christmas in the Pacific Northwest. _ _For almost four years, my bike has reliably gotten me from place to place. I love cycling in comparison to driving, because riding around in open air rather than a heavy metal shell allows me to feel more connected to, and appreciative of my community and surroundings. Further, using my bike is emission-free, and every commute offers natural exercise whenever I ride it, which makes me feel mentally refreshed and physically renewed every time I reach my destination and dismount. _ _Most significantly, I found that the simple choice of riding a bike instead of owning a car has saved me THOUSANDS of dollars in gas, insurance, repairs, and car payments that many of my peers are plagued with, offering me not just superior mental health compared to when I got around via car, but higher amounts of expendable income to spend on things that bring me joy than most drivers I know. Overall, I’ve never been happier on my commutes since making the switch to riding a bike, and in my years since doing so, my primary mode of transportation hasn’t contributed a single carbon emission towards climate change._ This story comes straight from my experiences, but **we’re also in need of stories from folks who yearn to live more sustainably, but feel as if they cannot due to personal or systemic barriers in the way.** These types of stories are equally, if not more important than hearing about positive changes, as they illustrate the way clean energy and sustainability are often made inaccessible to low income and BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, People of Color) communities, and the policy work that must be done to increase access to these groups. Whether you’ve bought a heat pump to cool your house during summer heat, switched to all-electric appliances, or chosen to exclusively ride public transportation – the possibilities for your stories are endless. _**Submit them to[ olcv@olcv.org](mailto:olcv@olcv.org?subject=Sustainability%20Stories) via email under the subject “Sustainability Stories,” **_and we’ll continue to broadcast our favorites by posting them on social media and our website. We also plan to share the most convincing submissions with Oregon’s elected officials in hopes that your stories will sway them to vote for legislation acting on climate change by illustrating the benefits that environmental sustainability and clean energy offer to the everyday people of Oregon. Thank you, we can't wait to continue reading your submissions! Will Bertellotti
Communications Coordinator, OLCV \----- FORWARD: ----- Dear supporter, As the 2022 midterm election looms close on the horizon, OLCV needs to hear from you more than ever. Specifically, we’re looking for any “sustainability stories” you might be willing to share with us, as our elected officials need to know about the positive effects that clean energy or sustainable practices have had on the lives of the everyday people of Oregon just like you. Stories stick with people. They persuade people better than any facts or figures ever could, and with your stories, we hope to convince our lawmakers that climate legislation is not just good for the planet, _but for people as well!_ _**Share your story by emailing it to[ olcv@olcv.org](mailto:olcv@olcv.org?subject=Sustainability%20Stories) using the subject “Sustainability Stories.”**_ **Have you:** switched to a heat pump to control the temperature of your house and felt far more comfortable this summer because of it? Made the transition from a fossil fuel-burning car to driving an electric vehicle, riding a bicycle, or taking public transportation to and from work, and seen a difference in your budget or mental health? Replaced your heavy polluter methane gas stove with an electric induction stove, and found that it cooks like a charm? Installed solar panels on your house and noticed how efficient of a power source they are? Taken up the habit of composting to feed plots at your community garden with strong nutrients, leading to a delicious harvest? Made concrete efforts at your small business to diminish its output of emissions? _Or, have you been itching to live more sustainably or switch to clean energy, but felt that there was something holding you back? _ Then you’re exactly the type of person whose stories we want to hear! In short, we’re looking for your positive experiences with making a switch to clean or electric energy, or more broadly by integrating environmentally sustainable practices into your life. However, we also want to hear from those who yearn to live in a more eco-friendly manner, but are unable to due to personal or systemic barriers preventing them from reasonably making such changes. The more compelling stories we are able to collect about how clean energy and sustainability have positively impacted lives, as well as testimonies about the structural blocks in place preventing access to such choices, the more likely we'll be to sway lawmakers in the direction of removing those blocks and prioritizing climate. Ultimately, our personal choices alone cannot stop climate change— a crisis caused largely by corporations that can only be truly addressed by systemic change. However, if we can collect enough stories to share with our elected officials, we’ll have a better shot at passing meaningful climate action in Oregon by showing them how much we all have to gain through a just transition to a clean energy economy. **To submit your tales of sustainability, clean energy, making the switch to electric, or the barriers you’ve faced in pursuing these changes, email[ olcv@olcv.org ](mailto:olcv@olcv.org?body=Sustainability%20Stories)using the subject line “Sustainability Stories”** with anywhere from _1-5 paragraphs describing your experience, including details about the lifestyle shift, why you made it, and how it’s positively altered your life – or if you’re writing about the challenges stopping you from taking up greener consumption habits – describe what factors are in your way, and why we need to get rid of them to guarantee equitable access to eco-friendly living for all. _ We will be accepting story submissions for an extended period of time, and hope to put your stories to good use by uplifting them on our website and social media platforms. We also plan to share our favorite stories with elected leaders to illustrate the immense benefits Oregon’s population could reap from substantive legislation to protect our climate and shift our state towards 100% clean energy. Thank you, we can’t wait to hear your stories! Will Bertellotti

## Matt & Mercy Schlapp on Beyond the Briefing...
This was a really fun conversation with my neighbors and friends, Matt & Mercy Schlapp. They discuss what motivated them to become political, climbing the ranks in DC, how they first met, the interesting role Nicolle Wallace played in their White House love triangle, the unexpected impact 9/11 had on them, growing CPAC, raising kids as public political figures and more. Don’t miss this episode:

[](https://seanspicer.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d009170fb4604b5974b5521bd&id=34b2cbecaa&e=f6564bbe3b)

Hello,
I’m Julie, the campaign manager for Admiral Mike Franken’s campaign here in Iowa against Chuck Grassley.
As you probably know, all the polls show we're in a very close race. Grassley’s approval ratings are the lowest they’ve ever been. But Mitch McConnell’s Super PACs are raising tens of millions of dollars to spend attacking Mike. If we’re going to finally send Grassley packing this November, it’s critical we be up on the air _now_ – before they start drowning us out in TV ads.
**It's so important that I authorized starting to run TV ads across Iowa a few weeks early, even though we didn’t _technically_ have all the money in our budget to do so just yet.**
We took this risk because we had to. Whether or not Democrats hold onto our Senate majority is going to be decided here in Iowa, and we won’t stand a chance if we don’t immediately introduce Mike to more voters before the Super PAC lies start. **So I bit the bullet and made the bet that grassroots donors like you would come through and help us fill our $100,000 budget gap...**
We need to do everything we can to defeat Grassley and protect our Senate majority. That means taking a few risks.

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9544b3f2a42d42cf83d5acf54f36f285&_e=0Q83Jzwwtul8eQTyprm0qZN6EzSxqKneAKwt8QKgN96kkF8seq2XfPggZ2Yqvv1k8TQjtWVf63uMgMpzFluoRXpK_qHwERazVDdlnrbZARAGpuWZsmNbepwxgivn4cIsaFkJfr15rP6JtGzHQ00rbx6SB_jd3D94_XOpJ9EyaCTmtVoLe9sDEEb_saxsjGg103XQXFpNrPn5g7UG5IsxI_JsjT3v57Ty4pJbYvShfOI8G0CaGavxQfdghbskTcUxV4Rm4GwHuVGpAW-i4g4ESO6YQkKsL4eJhaXAEHopQ_YHzhf9mLDlClUxMcwQjxF048mpZrmYhCmVTgqx6ztV9shLJoQaQkpBMca1qKhDDKVvYeiPTfRBnTfshCrCTGo3h7-CVAc_h5i2VDsDL8gLGRdKYfS-U_tgYNzHrFFok2Y%3D "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

subject: Kentucky’s next Senator
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Kentuckians deserve a Senator that fights for good jobs, expands access to
high quality, affordable healthcare, and champions public education.
That’s why today, I’m proud to announce that Charles Booker has my full
endorsement for U.S. Senate.

When we elect Charles this November, we will build a Kentucky — and
country — that works for everyone.

Peter, our Senator
should understand the power of our common bonds, and knows that we are
stronger when we stand together.

During my time as Governor, we have faced incredibly challenging times —
devastating floods, unprecedented tornadoes, and a crushing pandemic. I am
proud of the resilience, compassion, and determination the people of
Kentucky have shown in these hard times. That’s why we need a United
States Senator who will stand in the gap and fight by our side.

Charles has proven his tireless commitment to the people of Kentucky over
the years, and I am honored to endorse him as Kentucky’s next United
States Senator.

Thank you,

Gov. Andy Beshear

name: Tony Evers
subject: Thank you, Derek
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
body:
| Derek,

Thanks to your incredible surge of grassroots donations, we reached our ambitious end-of-month deadline goal!

In a race that’s virtually tied, we couldn’t afford to miss this goal – and thanks to your help we didn’t.

Unlike my radical opponent, Tim Michels, I don’t have a family fortune I can rely on.

I also can’t rely on unlimited support from Donald Trump, right-wing billionaires, and Super PACs. It’s your small dollar donations that make it possible for me to counter their attack ads, fund our organizing efforts, and get my message out.

So much is at stake, and we need to stick together. Tim Michels wants to take us back to the 19th century by supporting a pre-Civil War abortion ban and is more focused on appeasing Donald Trump than listening to the people of Wisconsin.

I’m a lifelong educator who’s proudly built my campaign one voter at a time, and I’m honored that you are with me. Together, if we continue to push in the same direction, we can defend abortion rights, keep fair elections, expand public education funding, and more.

This election will determine the future of our great state, and I can’t thank you enough for standing with me.

[If you have a moment, check out my new video on the stakes of the race and share with your friends and family!](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1563?t=5&akid=4412%2E1827488%2EI3Vul2)

Thank you for all that you do.

Tony

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Early in 2019, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC)
blacklisted vendors, staffers, and organizations that support primary
challengers to Democratic incumbents — officially putting the interests of
a handful of corporate-backed Democrats above the will of Democratic
voters.

It was a shocking attempt to protect corporate incumbents by blocking
working-class progressives from a slew of critical campaign resources
after AOC defeated the 4th most powerful Democrat in the House. The DCCC
issued this blacklist while corporate Democrats were employing consultants
who engage in union busting, GOP lobbying, and work for Big Pharma, Big
Oil, and right-wing foreign policy organizations.

House leadership was fine trying to stop the next AOC with their
blacklist, all while using corporate consultants who block progressive
change.

Our work at Justice Democrats is to upend the political establishment that
works with union busters and GOP lobbyists. And we’re doing it by
supporting the Squad and electing more progressives who will buck the
establishment.

While we fight for Medicare for All and a Green New Deal, we’re urging the
Democratic Party to end their work with corporate consultants and STOP
protecting corporate profits. Peter,
will you donate today to help us win more
primaries against the Democratic establishment and its Wall Street-backed
candidates?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113929?refcode=em20220901-24967&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24967%2E1203867%2EZ4INaa ]→ Yes, I can contribute right now to help Justice Democrats overcome
the odds and grow the Squad in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113929?refcode=em20220901-24967&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=24967%2E1203867%2EZ4INaa ]Contribute

Even after the DCCC instituted their blacklist, two of our recruits — Cori
Bush and Jamaal Bowman — still defeated long-time corporate incumbents in
2020. We were not afraid of the Democratic establishment and we continue
to win races despite the odds stacked against us.

The DCCC announced an end to the blacklist after the 2020 elections — it
was more of a PR nightmare for them than an effective tool against
progressive primaries. It hasn’t changed much of the Democratic Party’s
behavior though — House Speaker Nancy Pelosi supported conservative
anti-abortion Democrat Henry Cuellar against Justice Democrat Jessica
Cisneros. Pelosi said, “I support my incumbents. I support every one of
them.”

It should matter to Democrats WHO the incumbents are and WHAT they stand
for. Just like it should matter to Democrats who the consultants are that
work for their campaigns and organizations. If a consultant is doing union

Thanks to your grassroots support, we not only met – _we exceeded_ – our fundraising goal for the month of August.

Today, we just wanted to let you know how much we appreciate your support – and how much of a difference you are making. Your generosity is giving us a huge boost going into the final two months of this race.

Since Eric doesn’t take money from corporate PACs, we’re relying heavily on grassroots donors to pay for these crucial efforts.

Our community sees Eric as the most trustworthy candidate who -- just like he's done for 20 years as their meteorologist -- delivers honest facts to keep people safe. Now our job is to spread the word to undecided voters. Everyone needs to know how important this race is and why Eric is the right choice to represent us.

Thank you for all you do.

name: Working Families Party
subject: Water crisis in Jackson
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party National PAC (77 Sands St
body:
This is the result of a public policy failure and decades-long neglect. | | | Dear Peter, Seventeen years after Hurricane Katrina and one year after Hurricane Ida devastated communities along the Gulf Coast, 150,000 residents of Jackson, MS — a majority Black city — are once again the victims of a health and environmental crisis that could have been avoided. Four days ago, Jackson’s water treatment plant, which has had a long history of problems, finally failed. Since then, residents of Jackson and their families have been forced to go without running water. When they do see water come out of their faucets, it is discolored. They are being told by authorities not to drink it, and if they do shower with it, to do so with their mouths closed. And officials have said it's unclear when they will once again have safe access to water. Water is life. Without it, Jacksonians will not only suffer grave health consequences but also significant economic impacts in what is a chronically under-funded community, with schools and businesses being forced to close or spend their own resources to bring water to Mississippians in need. This didn’t happen overnight. This is the result of a public policy failure and decades-long neglect. clean_body: This is the result of a public policy failure and decades-long neglect. | | | Dear Peter, Seventeen years after Hurricane Katrina and one year after Hurricane Ida devastated communities along the Gulf Coast, 150,000 residents of Jackson, MS — a majority Black city — are once again the victims of a health and environmental crisis that could have been avoided. Four days ago, Jackson’s water treatment plant, which has had a long history of problems, finally failed. Since then, residents of Jackson and their families have been forced to go without running water. When they do see water come out of their faucets, it is discolored. They are being told by authorities not to drink it, and if they do shower with it, to do so with their mouths closed. And officials have said it's unclear when they will once again have safe access to water. Water is life. Without it, Jacksonians will not only suffer grave health consequences but also significant economic impacts in what is a chronically under-funded community, with schools and businesses being forced to close or spend their own resources to bring water to Mississippians in need. This didn’t happen overnight. This is the result of a public policy failure and decades-long neglect. name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: Tea Party Patriots Action responds to Biden’s hate-filled rhetoric
body:
| | |
---
Biden _**hates**_ Americans who disagree with him and who did not vote for him.

He never meant what [he said](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._E7mw) in January, 2020.

“To make progress, we have to stop treating our opponents as our enemies. They are not our enemies. They are Americans.” – _Joe Biden, November 7, 2020_ ([Video](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-CvYw)) During his Inaugural address, [Biden said](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NzM4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/LSxq_92FoI9gnedioj4PeQ), “The American story depends not on any one of us, not on some of us, but on all of us. We have much to do in this winter of peril and significant opportunities. With unity, we can do great things, important things.”

He added, “My whole soul is in this, uniting our nation, uniting our people. I ask every American to join me in this cause.” ([Video](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)) Joe Biden [vowed](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NzM4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/rqKi0uZ8Kztp5Nf_ta2Inw) to end the “season of darkness.”
However, his true colors and intentions have come in recent months and weeks:
* “This MAGA crowd is really the most extreme political organization that’s existed in American history, in recent American history,” [Biden told reporters](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NzM4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/uBkcKOCrdNrarKqF-qcdTw) at the White House, referring to Trump’s “Make America Great Again” movement. – _May 4, 2022_
* [Biden’s remarks](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NzM4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/YFHkXaJXIt7B7yfb7ql3EQ) at a [Reception](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) for the Democratic National Committee: “It’s not just — it’s not just Trump. It’s the –it’s the entire philosophy that underpins — it’s — I’m going say something — it’s almost like semi-fascism, the way in which it deals... We’re at a serious moment in our nation’s history,” he said. “The MAGA Republicans don’t just threaten our personal rights and economic security, they’re a threat to our very democracy. They refuse to accept the will of the people, they embrace political violence... What’s happened is there are not many real Republicans anymore ... I respect conservative Republicans, I don’t respect these MAGA Republicans.” _August 25, 2022_ ([Video](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-2jg))
* [Biden](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyNDQtYzA0YzQ1NzhiZTQ5NDJkZWE1OTNkZjkxNDVmNmQ3MjciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiOSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vdHdpdHRlci5jb20vam9lYmlkZW4vc3RhdHVzLzE1NjM2MjUxNDg0MTgyMzY0MTY_cz0yMSZ0PXo1WWZxM0xSM29OZkQwN2xIOUNvdkEmbWlkPTQ1NzM4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/SsjzDekrH8ermxSOIGJFCA): “In this moment, those who love this country—Democrats, Independents and mainstream Republicans—must be stronger, more determined, and more committed to saving America than MAGA Republicans are committed to destroying America.” _August 27, 2022_
* “You look at the definition of ‘fascism,’ and you think about what they’re doing in attacking our democracy ... I mean, that is what that is; it is very clear,” [said Jean Pierre](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-nCA8YlbhyA). _August 27, 2022_
* [White House Press Secretary](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) speaking for the President: “MAGA Republicans” are “an extreme threat to our democracy.” That is just facts.” ([Video](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)) _August 29, 2022_
* [Karine Jean-Pierre says](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._HetnVQ) that “MAGA Republicans,” (these are the very people who voted for Donald Trump and go to Trump rallies) are "a threat to our democracy, to our freedom, to our rights." _August 31, 2022_

Note that [Merriam-Webster dictionary states](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) that fascism “exalts nation and often race above the individual” – supporting “a centralized autocratic government headed by a dictatorial leader, severe economic and social regimentation, and forcible suppression of opposition.” **Let’s review:** The Biden administration continues to centralize the federal government, usurping the Constitutional rights and authority of the states and the citizenry. Biden behaves like a dictator, unilaterally changing laws on the fly, without Congress, and defying separation of powers and duties. His policies and actions result in more and more control and regimentation of our economy and social norms. Democrats across the board loudly and proudly discuss how conservatives should be silenced, cancelled, kicked off platforms, and imprisoned. And now he seems to be threatening Americans who simply disagree with him with potential military action against private citizens. [Biden](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyNDQtYzA0YzQ1NzhiZTQ5NDJkZWE1OTNkZjkxNDVmNmQ3MjciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMTUiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3R3aXR0ZXIuY29tL2Rpc2Nsb3NldHYvc3RhdHVzLzE1NjQ3MDYwNzkwMzYxMTY5OTQ_cz0yMSZ0PWdsV1BQVzRDOHoyeHhMLUVQeTc0eGcmbWlkPTQ1NzM4JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/zaP1CCRrN8Qv6yL_pbBEDA): “For those brave right-wing Americans... if you want to fight against the country, you need an F-15. You need something little more than a gun.” – _August 30, 2022_ ([Article](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-ueeCBVgA), [transcript](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.), [video](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-QTrd5Q))

Scholars agree that dehumanizing language that targets, isolates, and “otherizes” a specific group of people is the precursor extreme oppression of that particular group, and in every case of genocide, dehumanizing language preceded the genocide. A nation does not reach targeted oppression of one group and genocide in one step. It begins with language that paints one group of people as “the enemy,” building justification for extreme actions that would not be accepted otherwise. Biden and the rest of the Democrats are very clearly and deliberately stoking wrath and hatred of the over 70 million Americans who voted for Donald Trump in 2020. The only reason to fuel the hatred of a specific group of people in the way that Biden is currently doing is to give permission and justification for the targeting and oppression of that group. | I'm sorry for the bad news, Peter, but we fell 2.0% short of winning this special election.

The reason is simple - Pelosi knew what her donors would think if Republicans won this special election, so she detonated a money bomb in this race to buy her way to victory.

[**We can't allow that to happen again in the general election this November!**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9949ac73dd2549afa9e0ed1c796ef85a&_e=7tEafkA92m-TcvRZ0NHz72mWcUuG1nt3v43ZE41Y1wHQYF4G3kpvh61JEgbyOJSfkKGyRK0_WkFIiBhasqk06Fm6_AcTAl50qcMOprgymv1_JQ5ULXL1hT91Qq9ayJiyuDzkGLe1T7cJeL8HfCQ_7F8XsNumtGdqLIBzgB-iwpyuNlyganusJO_QbYvMC62G4_qvO6qugJ4w6g0AdYRzvweemdoXn4RpI-K_W4W8VdsILeHEVEceuvg-iGMkOaP3hdi65m2meGizhZi9kbv6_z2V6vioOQS6jHYborwNRpWZCGycPWNSfyrHVlaUmiEVjBTgOsSxFufI2mLYUUWLvLPcWz76oKmfJIj1bIItLIAQIy69ZgnbhEYbO2bQrxjgow-7vWX9PnQKaHuRCisQrg%3D%3D)

If we're going to have any chance of winning back Congress, then we need to regroup, refocus, and throw everything we have at winning the newly redrawn district.

[**But, to do that I need to know if you're still with me, Peter. Be honest, do you still want Republicans to win back the House from Pelosi?**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9949ac73dd2549afa9e0ed1c796ef85a&_e=7tEafkA92m-TcvRZ0NHz72mWcUuG1nt3v43ZE41Y1wHQYF4G3kpvh61JEgbyOJSfkKGyRK0_WkFIiBhasqk06Fm6_AcTAl50qcMOprgymv1_JQ5ULXL1hT91Qq9ayJiyuDzkGLe1T7cJeL8HfCQ_7F8XsNumtGdqLIBzgB-iwpyuNlyganusJO_QbYvMC62G4_qvO6qugJ4w6g0AdYRzvweemdoXn4RpI-K_W4W8VdsILeHEVEceuvg-iGMkOaP3Z9elA32iKBsrzL_rdPf4WJRE7-yqfXT64o4CIeRa-MGjSaRr2zPjSzAorfCboFTnVSzPWN8xLWwWEccxMBASn1N1Oyd-05SmHBsXo1eYxWGD0laSuTuiyxtEL-h95KB1iIPs7AkSYctNrZxAHxTVpQ%3D%3D)

[**I STILL STAND WITH MARC AND THE GOP**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9949ac73dd2549afa9e0ed1c796ef85a&_e=7tEafkA92m-TcvRZ0NHz72mWcUuG1nt3v43ZE41Y1wHQYF4G3kpvh61JEgbyOJSfkKGyRK0_WkFIiBhasqk06Fm6_AcTAl50qcMOprgymv1_JQ5ULXL1hT91Qq9ayJiyuDzkGLe1T7cJeL8HfCQ_7F8XsNumtGdqLIBzgB-iwpyuNlyganusJO_QbYvMC62G4_qvO6qugJ4w6g0AdYRzvweemdoXn4RpI-K_W4W8VdsILeHEVEceuvg-iGMkOaP3B0QTTWAdvkMXc3pOTgTk6sYRsSKVjh8nZqtQe5eTcI8tQyeleAtP2kpOS19g3BgWe15pkbQzPONzB6fUdFDBN9XSpN11scrbGYRrL9naAeqqeA91VOr8o7fa-YkDVWZb0T_UU2I2fk6W9YlnJHyZzw%3D%3D)
[**I CHANGED MY MIND - I WANT THE DEMOCRATS TO WIN**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9949ac73dd2549afa9e0ed1c796ef85a&_e=7tEafkA92m-TcvRZ0NHz72mWcUuG1nt3v43ZE41Y1wHQYF4G3kpvh61JEgbyOJSfkKGyRK0_WkFIiBhasqk06Fm6_AcTAl50qcMOprgymv1_JQ5ULXL1hT91Qq9ayJiyuDzkGLe1T7cJeL8HfCQ_7F8XsNumtGdqLIBzgB-iwpyuNlyganusJO_QbYvMC62G4_qvO6qugJ4w6g0AdYRzvweemdoXn4RpI-K_W4W8VdsILeHEVEceuvg-iGMkOaP3EvtCoLlN87Clqx63sEbWgKU8FHh27JjIPphZhUqX-zflaE6f7RWl1VTiFL9UGoTzj9fZaVX_y20J286rnxv7DCpiyRehvkLRwOlus3k8dAuOwjtxFmjOO_ND88uY6Xsyw9VW7CP3z1nYNDxFwux7Vw%3D%3D)
Please don't take this question lightly, Peter. **_If you're not with me in this fight then I need to know now because this isn't going to get easier._**

This was always going to be an uphill battle, and this special election loss proves that Washington Democrats are willing to say and spend anything to score a victory.

[**But, we have to pick ourselves up and get back in the fight**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9949ac73dd2549afa9e0ed1c796ef85a&_e=7tEafkA92m-TcvRZ0NHz72mWcUuG1nt3v43ZE41Y1wHQYF4G3kpvh61JEgbyOJSfkKGyRK0_WkFIiBhasqk06Fm6_AcTAl50qcMOprgymv1_JQ5ULXL1hT91Qq9ayJiyuDzkGLe1T7cJeL8HfCQ_7F8XsNumtGdqLIBzgB-iwpyuNlyganusJO_QbYvMC62G4_qvO6qugJ4w6g0AdYRzvweemdoXn4RpI-K_W4W8VdsILeHEVEceuvg-iGMkOaP3Y-dWKjU2Ke4q0iFHCYwXN1GT790Cz8OFYxynT7avKY9PJmizhfCCjoXFQcE-7fFsK38S0JZRWkeHH2DyDq-46CRYcr0-HipdtqNfpi0tMYtofAfgmIipYKB3bnets4zAzhYPA49xU7kExn9UPGXeNA%3D%3D) so we can prevent our country from falling deeper into the pockets of Hollywood and radical special interests!

[**STAND WITH MARC AND THE GOP**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9949ac73dd2549afa9e0ed1c796ef85a&_e=7tEafkA92m-TcvRZ0NHz72mWcUuG1nt3v43ZE41Y1wHQYF4G3kpvh61JEgbyOJSfkKGyRK0_WkFIiBhasqk06Fm6_AcTAl50qcMOprgymv1_JQ5ULXL1hT91Qq9ayJiyuDzkGLe1T7cJeL8HfCQ_7F8XsNumtGdqLIBzgB-iwpyuNlyganusJO_QbYvMC62G4_qvO6qugJ4w6g0AdYRzvweemdoXn4RpI-K_W4W8VdsILeHEVEceuvg-iGMkOaP3g8BTw6b6W-61rZad2XulLKicT5F4KeMNJ7CF0KTbyewLnDEXTjAfFV5Fbcrz7mQs4otnnvBjM_xFKNuDRayREhHE8YZ6L4PwX-xoYu_pC_Wy1SBFpZmj_oK2BzKbFCg-vgxM6lAs8nkH8xx6DIsrDQ%3D%3D)
If you're still with me in this fight to win back Congress in November, [**then please let me know before midnight tonight, so I can see who I'm able to count on still.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=9949ac73dd2549afa9e0ed1c796ef85a&_e=7tEafkA92m-TcvRZ0NHz72mWcUuG1nt3v43ZE41Y1wHQYF4G3kpvh61JEgbyOJSfkKGyRK0_WkFIiBhasqk06Fm6_AcTAl50qcMOprgymv1_JQ5ULXL1hT91Qq9ayJiyuDzkGLe1T7cJeL8HfCQ_7F8XsNumtGdqLIBzgB-iwpyuNlyganusJO_QbYvMC62G4_qvO6qugJ4w6g0AdYRzvweemdoXn4RpI-K_W4W8VdsILeHEVEceuvg-iGMkOaP3h5W5B4BwzVk0NeIUh5myD45_VHEB1dTHrkvafpUqTsw3uSf53rfKUet79YQrpOQRbbXXSwiTs7Z3_Hnnxb9pXs4QdSc3f4KoyUxyHynL9_FUo22ebVg_hcEqCGg4hoOFdHirpjMeaPoH1PBsf8UYuQ%3D%3D)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50113507/364655362/-1789705490?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3929-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNWFkZTQ0ZC00NjJhLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iVgdCF27vcMqXXF5IBH89XHzva_qROhd5ZgXWAAhZ1E=)
Friend – **my roots are planted deeply in Georgia soil.**

I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah – and I attended Morehouse College, a historically Black university in Atlanta. I went on what I called a "full faith" scholarship, meaning I didn't know how I would pay for my first full semester.
But through hard work and the support of my community, I was the first in my family to graduate from college – and then became the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church, the spiritual home of Martin Luther King Jr.

I know firsthand how attending an HBCU prepared me for a life of service – and I'm fighting tooth and nail in the Senate to make sure every kid has the opportunity to achieve their American dream.
**But this is going to be an uphill battle: Experts at NPR confirm that I'm the _most vulnerable_ Senate Democrat up for reelection, and recent polls show me falling 1 point behind. Beto, Amy, Nick, and the whole team are so proud of what we’re accomplishing together. We can’t wait to see how much we can get done in September.
With gratitude,
Team Beto
