name: =?utf-8?Q?Team=20Cavaleri?=
subject: September Newsletter
body:
An update from the Cavaleri for Congress Campaign trail | | |
---
| |
# Friends of Cavaleri for Congress,
---
| First things first, as you know, we finished top two in the First Congressional District's primary election and are sprinting to the November ballot! Our success thus far is due to everyone’s incredible generosity and unwavering support. We are so blessed to have all of you in our lives, “We the People” will be the key to victory on November 8th.

Our campaign is in its final phase, and there is a strategy element in play, so I won’t give away too much of the secret sauce. We took a week off after the primary to allow people to digest the first half of the campaign season. Since that time, the ballots have now been certified, and we are full steam ahead to the general.

We continue to doorbell throughout the district on a massive and targeted scale. The ground game has always been a top priority and will continue to be all the way to November. Our teams are currently in both Snohomish and King County and have hit tens of thousands of doors. All in all, we are on track to where our canvassers will have reached nearly 60,000 voters by the time we hit election day. This is an amazing feat, and a necessary component to winning in November.

Please check the campaign's website [**events calendar**](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=f7f658a615&e=4003acec22) for upcoming events. A special shout out to the Chinese American Patriot Alliance (CAPA) for hosting our most recent event in Bellevue, and the Electric Mirror Company in Everett for doing the same. Both were ultra-successful and vital to the campaigns outreach and fundraising efforts.
---
|
---
|
---
| On Tuesday, September 13th, we will have our “Shoot with the Deputy” event at Securite gun club in Woodinville, hosted by Don and Mindy Nelson. Tickets are available on the campaign’s website, so don’t miss out!
---
|
---
| [PURCHASE TICKETS HERE](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=7a1f6728aa&e=4003acec22 "PURCHASE TICKETS HERE")
---
| We will continue to attend public events in the district. The parade in Monroe, which kicked off the Evergreen State Fair, was amazing. We had over 30 volunteers march with us. Thank you, citizens of Monroe, for making us feel so welcome. I will be attending the Evergreen State Fair on Saturday evening. The following week, we will be attending the Ukrainian festival in King County on September 10th, so keep your eyes and ears open for upcoming events in a community near you.
---
|
---
| Lastly, we just finished filming our first TV commercial. Thank you, Doug Basler, for the in-kind donation to the team. Our goal is to get it on the air as many times as possible between September 11th and election day.
---
| [ ](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=d09e6b6f7a&e=4003acec22)
---
| Your financial support is critical for this endeavor. My opponent is worth 80 million dollars and will spend all of it to protect her seat. We have an opportunity to send her packing and neutralize this radical administration. This takes everyone’s participation and a recognition of the magnitude of this moment in America. Please do your part and help me to help you. When I win, you win. My track record speaks for itself.

Please donate or volunteer today. Each day that passes, is another missed opportunity. Let’s cross the finish line together; and make our children’s America a better place.
God Bless,
---
|

| | | | | Peter _**,**_ did you see this great news? She. Did. It. Mary Peltola, a seasoned state legislator and proven campaigner, BEAT Sarah Palin in an incredible upset in this week’s special election. We told you we believed this great candidate could become the first Alaska Native to win an election to Congress, and she did it!! **Peltola's great campaign--including steadfast support for a women's right to choose, fighting to protect Alaska's natural resources and standing up for Alaskan workers--got it done by 3%, 51.5%-48.5%. The toxic, nasty, right wing zealotry of Palin was also helpful in sealing her fate.** So we have good news and bad news. The bad news is that this was a special election for the seat left open when Rep. Don Young passed away, and there will be a repeat in November. The good news, we have an extra Democratic seat in Congress for those few months, Peltola will be an incumbent when she runs in November and she'll benefit from taking on the toxic Palin yet again.

Friend, we need your help. As Joe Biden attempts to save the failing campaigns of Mandela Barnes and Tony Evers by pandering to us here in Wisconsin, we’re preparing to send a clear message. Isn’t it ironic that Joe Biden is coming to Wisconsin on Labor Day after completely failing our workers just last week? **To welcome Biden to Wisconsin, we’re organizing a show of force and we need**** _YOU_****to show up on Monday!** We must show Tony Evers and Mandela Barnes that Joe Biden can’t save their failing campaigns, and protest the many ways the Democrats have failed Wisconsin. Let us know if you can make it to Milwaukee in the early afternoon on Monday by signing up at the link below.
